2609.26874.zh: 用 TESS 可见光相曲线研究高温小型系外行星的反射光，区分高反照率与大气热输送对较低日面亮温的影响。
2609.26874.en: Uses visible-light TESS phase curves to distinguish reflective surfaces or clouds from atmospheric heat transport on hot small planets.

2609.26894.zh: 结合 JWST、HST 与既有测光资料，研究 TOI-2109 b 的凌星时刻变化及潜在伴星和轨道衰减解释。
2609.26894.en: Combines JWST, HST and archival photometry to investigate transit-timing variations, a possible companion and orbital decay in TOI-2109 b.

2609.26917.zh: 模拟不同放射性元素丰度下类地行星内部热演化、磁场和大气流失的耦合，比较不同宿主恒星环境。
2609.26917.en: Simulates coupled interior cooling, magnetic evolution and atmospheric loss for Earth-like planets with different radiogenic budgets and host stars.

2609.27013.zh: 比较 M 矮星单凌星与多凌星系统的金属丰度和轨道特征，讨论其形成与演化差异。
2609.27013.en: Compares metallicities and orbital properties of M-dwarf systems with one or multiple transiting planets, probing differences in their origins.

2609.27025.zh: 通过三维局地剪切盒模拟，考察压力隆起的恢复强度如何影响毫米颗粒聚集以及微行星形成。
2609.27025.en: Uses three-dimensional shearing-box simulations to test how pressure-bump reinforcement affects millimetre-grain concentration and planetesimal formation.

2609.27415.zh: 对 Kepler-223 四行星共振链进行高分辨率 N 体积分与稳定性分析，研究长期轨道保护机制。
2609.27415.en: Uses high-resolution N-body integrations and stability maps to revisit long-term protection in the four-planet resonant chain of Kepler-223.

2609.27443.zh: 利用三维形状模型分析快速自转小行星表面稳定性，讨论内聚力、离心作用与近表面轨道环境。
2609.27443.en: Models surface stability and nearby orbital dynamics of a rapidly rotating asteroid, including cohesion and strong centrifugal effects.

2609.27474.zh: 依据 MAVEN 与天问一号观测研究火星太阳风边界的开尔文—亥姆霍兹涡旋，关注局地磁场与大气逃逸的联系。
2609.27474.en: Studies Kelvin–Helmholtz vortices at Mars using MAVEN and Tianwen-1 measurements, linking local magnetic conditions to plasma mixing and atmospheric escape.

2609.27562.zh: 建立耦合流动与传热的 SPH 冰火山模型，模拟木卫二冰熔岩的铺展和冷却，解释光滑平原形成。
2609.27562.en: Develops an SPH model of cryolava flow and cooling to investigate the formation of smooth plains on Europa.

2609.27569.zh: 介绍 Juice 亚毫米波仪在地月引力助推期间的运行安排，涉及木星大气、冰卫星外逸层及表层热物性的观测需求。
2609.27569.en: Describes Juice-SWI operations during the lunar–Earth gravity assist and their connection to atmospheric, exospheric and surface-thermal measurements.

2609.27622.zh: 讨论 Ariel 大规模行星大气观测如何约束化学多样性，并将垂直混合、光化学和大气环流纳入解释框架。
2609.27622.en: Discusses how Ariel can constrain atmospheric chemical diversity, emphasizing vertical mixing, photochemistry and circulation-driven disequilibrium.

2609.27722.zh: 结合测光、光谱与偏振观测，研究双小行星 Atira 的表面组成及其与含水碳质球粒陨石的联系。
2609.27722.en: Combines photometry, spectroscopy and polarimetry to investigate Atira’s surface composition and its connection to hydrated carbonaceous meteorites.

2609.28166.zh: 将 HR 4796 碎屑盘散射光观测与实验结果相结合，利用相函数、偏振和反射率约束尘埃物理化学性质。
2609.28166.en: Combines scattered-light observations and experiments to constrain dust properties in HR 4796 through phase functions, polarization and reflectance.

2609.27031.zh: 用程序升温脱附实验比较不同水冰和甲醇冰基底上甲酸甲酯的结合与脱附行为，研究冰组成对气相释放的影响。
2609.27031.en: Uses temperature-programmed desorption to examine how water and methanol ice substrates affect methyl-formate binding and release into the gas phase.

2609.27039.zh: 交叉匹配多波段巡天，构建船帆—船底区域红外超候选源目录，并通过光谱能量分布分析其辐射性质。
2609.27039.en: Builds a multi-survey infrared-excess catalog in Vela–Carina and characterizes candidates using spectral energy distributions.

2609.27140.zh: 通过 JWST 探测器连续读出之间的差分减少运动目标拖迹，提高存档图像中小太阳系天体的检出灵敏度。
2609.27140.en: Uses differences between JWST detector reads to shorten moving-object trails and improve searches for small Solar System bodies.

2609.27997.zh: 利用高分辨率 ALMA 观测研究演化双星 IRAS 08544-4431 周围尘埃盘的不对称结构及其演化。
2609.27997.en: Uses high-resolution ALMA observations to examine dust asymmetries and disk evolution around the evolved binary IRAS 08544-4431.

2609.28001.zh: 评估 Ariel 高时间分辨率测光探测恒星耀斑的能力，并讨论耀斑对系外行星凌星光谱的干扰。
2609.28001.en: Assesses Ariel’s ability to detect stellar flares with rapid photometry and discusses their effects on exoplanet transit spectroscopy.

2509.12737.zh: 从逆问题角度恢复高分辨率观测中的行星大气透射光谱，针对传统处理方法在模型依赖和谱线恢复上的限制。
2509.12737.en: Frames high-resolution exoplanet transmission-spectrum recovery as an inverse problem, addressing limitations of conventional analysis methods.

2606.14646.zh: 提出统一演化模型，将内部冷却、凝固、大气流失及氢氦在岩浆中的溶解结合起来，研究次海王星半径演化。
2606.14646.en: Introduces a unified sub-Neptune evolution model coupling cooling, solidification, atmospheric loss and hydrogen–helium dissolution in magma.

2609.08710.zh: 用更新轨道解与轨道克隆的 N 体积分重新评估半人马天体寿命及其动力学分类的稳定性。
2609.08710.en: Revisits Centaur lifetimes and dynamical classifications with updated orbital solutions and N-body integrations of orbital clones.

2609.24283.zh: 检验暗彗星 1998 KY26 可能为失联航天器的假说，结合其自转、反照率和非引力加速度讨论可行性。
2609.24283.en: Tests the hypothesis that dark comet 1998 KY26 is a lost spacecraft, considering its rotation, albedo and non-gravitational acceleration.

2605.14971.zh: 提出融入干涉测量点扩散函数的神经网络去噪方法，以原行星盘合成观测检验图像恢复效果。
2605.14971.en: Develops interferometry-informed neural denoising using the point-spread function, tested on synthetic protoplanetary-disk observations.

2606.05237.zh: 介绍 GREX-PLUS 任务的科学目标与红外仪器方案，包括行星系统形成、原行星盘水雪线和宇宙早期星系研究。
2606.05237.en: Outlines GREX-PLUS science and infrared instrumentation, including planetary-system formation, disk water snowlines and early galaxies.

2607.24418.zh: 提出尘埃—气体双流体分裂通量算法，改善强耦合条件下质量通量不一致导致的人工尘气比变化。
2607.24418.en: Develops a split-flux dust–gas method to reduce artificial dust-to-gas ratio variations caused by inconsistent fluxes in strong coupling.

2609.15331.zh: 扩展 SPAMMS 三维恒星光谱建模的大气模型网格，使其能够处理更广的恒星类型及非球对称表面效应。
2609.15331.en: Expands the atmosphere grids in SPAMMS for three-dimensional spectral synthesis across more stellar types and non-spherical surfaces.

2609.26890.zh: 提出保留原有物理模拟器的数据同化平滑方法，用非高斯分布描述状态轨迹并支持模拟器参数校准。
2609.26890.en: Introduces a non-Gaussian data-assimilation smoother that retains the prescribed physical simulator and supports parameter calibration.

2609.27093.zh: 用钠激光雷达和流星雷达研究阿拉斯加中间层—低热层的十二小时风场波动及其冬季增强特征。
2609.27093.en: Uses sodium lidar and meteor radar to investigate wintertime enhancement of twelve-hour wind oscillations over Alaska.

2609.27769.zh: 研究环境阈值指标的替代数据检验，说明在原始变量或聚合指标层面设置零假设会改变统计推断。
2609.27769.en: Shows how placing surrogate-test constraints before or after threshold aggregation changes inference for environmental indices.

2605.07167.zh: 提出利用时空红外图像的神经网络降水反演方法，旨在改进多卫星融合降水产品的红外估计部分。
2605.07167.en: Introduces a spatiotemporal infrared neural retrieval to improve the infrared contribution to merged satellite precipitation products.

2609.27907.zh: 用三维热力—力学地球动力模型检验地壳厚度差异及非弹性变形加热对欧洲局地火山活动的贡献。
2609.27907.en: Uses three-dimensional thermomechanical models to test how crustal structure and inelastic heating can localize European volcanism.

2609.28426.zh: 通过离散元模拟比较不规则岩石碎片在静态与动态载荷下的强度和刚度，评估几何形状的影响。
2609.28426.en: Uses discrete-element simulations to quantify how irregular rock-fragment geometry affects strength and stiffness under static and dynamic loading.

2605.13594.zh: 将基础原子模型与第一性原理结果比较，评估其描述地核条件下铁合金物态、声子和熔化性质的能力。
2605.13594.en: Benchmarks foundational atomistic models against ab initio results for iron-alloy phases, phonons and melting under Earth-core conditions.

2608.21045.zh: 从地震现场视频提取随时间变化的地表位移，并比较光流与模板匹配对相机运动和录制误差的处理。
2608.21045.en: Extracts time-resolved fault displacement from earthquake video, comparing optical-flow and template-matching approaches to recording artifacts.

2609.26816.zh: 建立刚度条件化的神经演化模型，联合表示流场和柔性板状态，预测不同刚度下的流固耦合响应。
2609.26816.en: Develops a stiffness-conditioned neural evolution model for coupled flow and flexible-plate dynamics across distinct response regimes.

2609.26833.zh: 利用旋转群表示分析各向异性磁流体湍流中的相干结构，比较高斯与非高斯磁场分布的相关尺度。
2609.26833.en: Uses rotation-group representations to study coherent structures and correlation scales in Gaussian and non-Gaussian anisotropic magnetic turbulence.

2609.27062.zh: 给出二维 Kolmogorov 流的大量精确稳态解，为从动力系统角度分析湍流与瞬态行为提供参考。
2609.27062.en: Presents a large catalog of exact steady states of two-dimensional Kolmogorov flow for dynamical-systems studies of turbulence and transients.

2609.27137.zh: 耦合流动模拟与声学类比，研究悬停旋翼中次级涡与叶片相互作用产生的准音调噪声。
2609.27137.en: Combines flow simulations and acoustic analogies to investigate quasi-tonal noise from secondary-vortex interactions with hovering rotor blades.

2609.27228.zh: 提出基于米散射的液体射流表面扰动测量方法，通过散射条纹反演突破常规成像对纳米尺度扰动的限制。
2609.27228.en: Develops a Mie-scattering inversion method to resolve nanoscale surface disturbances on liquid jets beyond conventional imaging limits.

2609.27292.zh: 用直接数值模拟研究聚合物弹性如何改变二维湍流结构及能量传输，并区分弱弹性和弹性激活状态。
2609.27292.en: Uses direct simulations to study how polymer elasticity changes two-dimensional turbulence structures and scale-by-scale energy transfer.

2609.27512.zh: 考察随机强迫二维流体在快速平流极限下的统计分布，研究能量向最低傅里叶模态集中的现象。
2609.27512.en: Studies stationary statistics of randomly forced two-dimensional flows in the fast-advection limit, focusing on concentration in the lowest Fourier modes.

2609.27568.zh: 通过直接数值模拟与谱模态分解，研究超临界翼型跨声速抖振的起始、主导模态与声学反馈路径。
2609.27568.en: Uses direct simulations and spectral mode decomposition to investigate transonic-buffet onset, dominant modes and acoustic feedback paths.

2609.27892.zh: 分析稀薄气体逆温度梯度热流的可观测性，指出复现热流并不必然唯一确定高阶输运闭合状态。
2609.27892.en: Examines observability in rarefied heat transport, showing why reproducing counter-gradient heat flux need not uniquely identify higher-order closure states.

2609.27943.zh: 根据多孔介质直接数值模拟，讨论孔尺度对湍流结构的限制，并建立多孔—自由流复合区域的建模思路。
2609.27943.en: Uses pore-scale simulation insights to model turbulent flow across porous and clear-fluid regions, emphasizing limits imposed by pore size.

2609.28151.zh: 用直接模拟蒙特卡洛方法研究腔体圆角与克努森数对稀薄气体环流、温度和密度分布的影响。
2609.28151.en: Uses direct simulation Monte Carlo to examine how corner rounding and Knudsen number affect rarefied-cavity flow and thermodynamic fields.

2609.28173.zh: 综述湍流强迫尺度以上的大尺度动力与统计性质，比较三维能量均分及二维逆级联背景下的结构。
2609.28173.en: Reviews dynamics and statistics above the forcing scale, contrasting three-dimensional equipartition with large-scale structures in two-dimensional inverse cascades.

2609.28355.zh: 构建微重力下液体晃荡与柔性航天器的分区流固耦合求解器，并用实验和能量收支检验数值一致性。
2609.28355.en: Develops a partitioned solver for microgravity sloshing and flexible spacecraft dynamics, checked with experiments and energy-balance diagnostics.

2605.19796.zh: 从滤波玻尔兹曼方程出发研究湍流闭合，强调碰撞项中的非马尔可夫效应与未解析尺度相关性。
2605.19796.en: Develops turbulence closure from the filtered Boltzmann equation, emphasizing non-Markovian collision dynamics and unresolved correlations.

2609.15762.zh: 提出结合非线性编码器和 Koopman 近似的数据同化框架，比较稀疏观测下流场重建与前向预测的表现差异。
2609.15762.en: Combines a nonlinear encoder and Koopman-like dynamics for sparse-observation flow assimilation, distinguishing sensing skill from forecasting accuracy.

2609.23787.zh: 将偏振与测速联合用于黏弹性应力反演，分析标定、误差协方差和低延迟量条件下的可辨识性。
2609.23787.en: Combines polarimetry and velocimetry for viscoelastic-stress inference, examining calibration, error covariance and identifiability at low retardance.

2609.24368.zh: 推导变形圆形腔体中稳流与拉格朗日输运的解析解，比较壁面运动条件对平均流强度和结构的影响。
2609.24368.en: Derives closed-form streaming and Lagrangian transport in a deforming circular cavity, comparing mean flows under different wall kinematics.

2609.24866.zh: 推导多液滴局地蒸发通量的渐近表达式，刻画液滴间蒸发屏蔽以及由此驱动的液体和颗粒输运。
2609.24866.en: Derives spatially resolved evaporation fluxes for multiple droplets, linking evaporative shielding to liquid flow and particle transport.

2510.12203.zh: 综述湍流与恒星形成模拟中的数值进展，包括磁流体、辐射流体、反馈和宇宙线输运方法。
2510.12203.en: Reviews numerical advances in turbulence and star-formation simulations, including magnetohydrodynamics, radiation transport and feedback methods.

2603.19561.zh: 提出自适应物理信息神经网络，模拟双孔隙网络的耦合流动，并支持参数反演和数据同化。
2603.19561.en: Develops an adaptive physics-informed neural framework for coupled dual-network porous flow, including inverse modeling and data assimilation.

2607.25385.zh: 推广电解质溶液中释放离子胶体的互易定理，研究次级电荷云对电泳、扩散泳和自推进的影响。
2607.25385.en: Generalizes the reciprocal theorem for ion-releasing colloids, examining how secondary charge clouds affect electrophoresis, diffusiophoresis and propulsion.

doi:10.1038/d41586-026-02922-6.zh: 新闻报道从连续介质近似的适用范围讨论 Navier–Stokes 研究进展，比较玻尔兹曼方程、分子模拟和多尺度方法，并指出 AI 辅助建模不等于已经解决湍流问题。
doi:10.1038/d41586-026-02922-6.en: A news report discussing continuum limits, kinetic and molecular approaches, and the role of AI in fluid modelling.

doi:10.1038/s41586-026-11058-6.zh: 汇集多种传染病暴发记录，分析社会与环境因素和暴发风险的关系。研究强调人口、牲畜、森林破碎化及降水变化的共同作用，并考虑报告偏差。
doi:10.1038/s41586-026-11058-6.en: Abstract Emerging infectious diseases are a hallmark of the Anthropocene 1,2 . Human-driven ecosystem changes and human–wildlife–livestock contact can drive the emergence of zoonotic and vector-borne diseases 3–5 , but how much these processes shape landscapes of outbreak risk is poorly understood, beyond a few well-studied systems 6–8 .

doi:10.1126/science.adw4498.zh: 结合锰—铬年代学与氧同位素温度约束，研究龙宫小行星及 Ivuna 陨石的早期演化，为太阳系最初阶段的母体形成与水作用提供线索。
doi:10.1126/science.adw4498.en: Most carbonaceous chondrite (CC) meteorites contain abundant chondrules, millimeter-scale spherical inclusions of previously molten material. Ivuna-type carbonaceous chondrites (CIs) do not contain chondrules, nor do samples of the carbonaceous asteroid Ryugu.

doi:10.1126/science.aem4439.zh: 这是一则关于 AI 参与 Navier–Stokes 数学问题研究的新闻报道。简短摘要聚焦数学界对其影响的争论，未提供足以评估具体数学成果的细节。
doi:10.1126/science.aem4439.en: Solution to Navier-Stokes problem has mathematicians at odds over AI’s implications for field

doi:10.1073/pnas.2520315122.zh: 构建城市暴雨内涝影响评估框架，将社会脆弱性、淹水暴露和关键基础设施联系起来，以纽约案例展示直接淹水之外的服务中断影响。
doi:10.1073/pnas.2520315122.en: Extreme precipitation events are increasing their frequency and intensity across the United States, posing growing risks to urban communities through pluvial flooding. Effective adaptation against pluvial flooding through structural and nonstructural measures requires understanding the spatial distribution of flood risks across urban populations and critical infrastructures.

doi:10.1073/pnas.2532733123.zh: 利用巴塔哥尼亚附近海洋沉积记录与模拟，探讨大西洋翻转环流减弱如何通过南北半球气候联系、降水和温度变化影响冰盖排放。
doi:10.1073/pnas.2532733123.en: The Atlantic Meridional Overturning Circulation (AMOC) transports heat globally, and its potential weakening would be crucial for future climate projections. Valuable insights into climatic impacts of AMOC slowdowns can be gained from the last glacial period, when millennial-scale AMOC reductions recurrently triggered large-scale reorganizations of the atmosphere-ocean system.

doi:10.1073/pnas.2600775123.zh: 利用 GRACE 观测与回归方法提高陆地水储量变化的空间解析能力，分析长期趋势中水资源利用、气候变化及冰川变化的作用。
doi:10.1073/pnas.2600775123.en: Human activities have directly altered the water cycle through water management, aquifer pumping, agricultural irrigation, and land use change. Although satellite gravimetry has transformed global hydrological research, its coarse resolution limits attribution of freshwater change to human activities at many management-relevant scales.

doi:10.1073/pnas.2606123123.zh: 结合加纳地区可可产量与逐日气象资料，评估湿季强降水和旱季干旱对年际产量的影响，并比较不同产区的气候敏感性。
doi:10.1073/pnas.2606123123.en: There is a growing need for human-centered weather and climate forecasts that provide actionable information to farmers and other stakeholders. Cocoa, which sustains the livelihoods of nearly six million smallholder farmers, illustrates this need: Recent production shortfalls have threatened incomes, yet their underlying causes remain unclear, with explanations invoking both climatic and nonclimatic factors.

doi:10.1073/pnas.2621019123.zh: 通过大量病毒基因组的系统发育与传播动力学分析，重建留尼汪岛基孔肯雅热疫情传播，讨论人口分布及免疫积累对疫情演化的影响。
doi:10.1073/pnas.2621019123.en: Réunion Island experienced a massive chikungunya virus epidemic in 2024–2025, with >54,000 confirmed cases. This is the second major chikungunya epidemic on the island, following the first one that peaked 20 years ago.

doi:10.1073/pnas.2616574123.zh: 利用第一性原理计算研究锌同位素分馏，检验碳酸岩碳源。结果支持再循环碳酸盐参与深部碳循环，而非简单归因于地幔原始碳。
doi:10.1073/pnas.2616574123.en: Carbonatite-forming magmas provide a critical window into the deep carbon cycle, but their ultimate carbon sources are debated. Here, we present first-principles calculations based on density functional theory and demonstrate that incipient mantle melting in the presence of primordial carbon produces carbonated melts enriched in light zinc (Zn) isotopes relative to the mantle.

doi:10.1073/pnas.2600758123.zh: 结合实验与理论研究弹性褶皱对液滴运动的控制，揭示液滴尺寸和基底应变如何影响弹性毛细相互作用，为可调控流体输运提供机制。
doi:10.1073/pnas.2600758123.en: Creases, localized indentations arising from elastic instabilities at strained soft interfaces, autonomously gate and steer droplets via long-range elastocapillary repulsion. We demonstrate that creases impose a sharp, strain-tunable threshold for droplets: Droplets below a critical radius halt at a finite distance upstream, while larger droplets traverse the crease.

doi:10.1073/pnas.2606852123.zh: 通过实验约束 HO₂ 自反应速率，并检验水汽与压力影响；将更新后的反应动力学用于大气化学模拟，评估对 HOx 和过氧化氢的影响。
doi:10.1073/pnas.2606852123.en: The hydroperoxy radical (HO 2 ) self-reaction is an important radical termination pathway under low-NO tropospheric conditions and a major gas-phase source of hydrogen peroxide (H 2 O 2 ), a key oxidant reservoir. Here we determine HO 2 self-reaction kinetics across atmospherically relevant temperatures and pressures and over a range of water vapor and methanol concentrations, using a collinear photolysis–probe geometry with cross-validated ultraviolet and mid-infrared absorption.

doi:10.1038/s41561-026-02094-y.zh: 研究简报介绍基于火星风场的拉格朗日追踪：哈德莱胞边界可抑制内外混合，胞上方却存在快速跨极输运；快速温度弛豫削弱涡旋，使平均流主导。
doi:10.1038/s41561-026-02094-y.en: Particle tracking reveals a transport barrier around the Martian Hadley cell and a pole-to-pole pathway above it.

doi:10.1038/s41561-026-02069-z.zh: 结合长期气压记录与气候模拟研究大西洋—欧洲急流的强度、倾斜和纬度变化，比较历史变率与未来冷季环流响应。
doi:10.1038/s41561-026-02069-z.en: Abstract The Atlantic–European jet stream is a key driver of weather extremes in Europe, yet its recent variability and trends remain poorly understood. Here we investigate daily changes in jet strength, tilt and latitudinal extent from 1725 to 2100 using pressure data from four European stations alongside climate model simulations.

doi:10.1038/s41561-026-02104-z.zh: 结合高压实验研究火星核幔边界附近的熔融条件，讨论富铁高密度熔体如何形成稳定深部层，为解释火星内部结构提供约束。
doi:10.1038/s41561-026-02104-z.en: Abstract Geophysical observations from the InSight mission suggest anomalously low seismic velocities near the Martian core–mantle boundary, possibly indicating a molten silicate layer. Such a layer would have major implications for the thermal and chemical evolution of Mars, but its origin remains poorly constrained because experimental data on iron-rich Martian melts at deep-mantle conditions remain scarce.

doi:10.1038/s41550-026-02981-9.zh: 结合 FAST 与甚大阵列对仙女座星系的中性氢观测，比较超新星泡的能量注入与湍流耗散，检验超新星反馈维持星系尺度湍流的能力。
doi:10.1038/s41550-026-02981-9.en: Supernovae are among the leading candidates for powering galactic-scale turbulence. Supernovae drive expanding shells of neutral atomic hydrogen (H I ) known as superbubbles. Due to the lack of a sensitive, dynamically complete, galaxy-wide census, superbubbles have not been demonstrated to dominate the galactic-scale turbulent energy budget. Here we present a combined Five-Hundred-Meter Aperture

doi:10.1038/s41550-026-02976-6.zh: 利用铁陨石的硫含量与铁价态约束早期星子的基质比例，发现最早形成的外太阳系星子也受到气动分选影响，将这一机制延伸至行星形成初期。
doi:10.1038/s41550-026-02976-6.en: Carbonaceous (CC) chondrites from the outer Solar System are mixtures of fine-grained, volatile-rich matrix and thermally sintered, volatile-poor chondrules. Among CC chondrite parent bodies that accreted ~2–4 million years after calcium–aluminium-rich inclusions (CAIs), matrix fraction increases with accretion time, consistent with aerodynamic sorting in the protoplanetary disk. Whether this proc

doi:10.1175/jas-d-25-0151.1.zh: 通过对不同高度大气施加约束的模拟，区分边界层与自由对流层斜压性对北极气旋的作用，分析对流层顶极涡及冷暖心结构的影响。
doi:10.1175/jas-d-25-0151.1.en: Abstract Arctic cyclones (ACs) have large impacts on sea-ice redistribution and are hazardous to communities in the region, yet the structure and evolution of summer ACs is not fully understood. We aim to link mechanisms that strengthen ACs to their structure at the time of maximum Eady Growth Rate (maxEGR) and minimum sea level pressure (minSLP) for both cold-core and warm-core cyclones.

doi:10.5194/acp-26-12771-2026.zh: 将动态 TenStream 三维辐射求解器与大涡模拟耦合，解释云影错位及地表通量变化如何促进云街组织、云体增厚和液态水增加。
doi:10.5194/acp-26-12771-2026.en: Radiative transfer is an inherently three-dimensional (3D) process that, for computational reasons, is still approximated as one-dimensional (1D) in most atmospheric models. To address this limitation, Maier et al. (2024) introduced the dynamic TenStream solver, which reduces the cost of 3D radiative transfer calculations through incomplete solves.

doi:10.5194/acp-26-12837-2026.zh: 利用 SOFOG3D 多仪器观测评估 Meso-NH 对雾的垂直微物理结构和生命周期的模拟，诊断液态水及滴数浓度偏差与可能缺失的过程。
doi:10.5194/acp-26-12837-2026.en: This study evaluates the representation of fog microphysics in high-resolution simulations from the Meso-NH model using the two-moment LIMA microphysical scheme, based on data from the SOFOG3D field campaign. This campaign combines remote sensing and vertical microphysical observations from a tethered balloon.

doi:10.5194/acp-26-12865-2026.zh: 模拟洁净海洋边界层中新粒子的形成与增长，讨论降水后的低粒子负荷条件下，二甲基硫和氨如何生成可能成为云凝结核的粒子。
doi:10.5194/acp-26-12865-2026.en: New particle formation (NPF) enhances the concentration of cloud condensation nuclei (CCN) over the oceans, thereby affecting the radiative balance and, consequently, Earth's climate. The literature suggest that marine NPF predominantly occurs in the free troposphere, as the extensive surface area of sea spray aerosols and limited precursor gases suppress NPF in the marine boundary layer (MBL).

doi:10.5194/acp-26-12925-2026.zh: 结合卫星反演、地面观测和水文资料比较三次厄尔尼诺期间印尼泥炭火排放，指出地下水位和土壤含水量可显著调节火烧深度与气体释放。
doi:10.5194/acp-26-12925-2026.en: Indonesian peatlands store vast amounts of carbon that are highly vulnerable to fire during El Niño-driven droughts. When ignited, peat releases large quantities of greenhouse gases and other species with significant environmental impacts, including hydrogen cyanide (HCN), a sensitive tracer of smouldering combustion.

doi:10.5194/acp-26-13055-2026.zh: 结合气候化学和辐射传输模型，评估太阳掩星卫星对平流层氧化铝、方解石粒子注入的可探测性，并检验其信号与自然变率的区分。
doi:10.5194/acp-26-13055-2026.en: Stratospheric aerosol injections (SAI) have been proposed as a potential climate intervention to mitigate some effects of global warming. This method involves the idea of injecting sulphur dioxide into the stratosphere.

doi:10.5194/acp-26-13069-2026.zh: 耦合辐射传输和量子化学计算，更新卤代烃的辐射效率估计，重点分析水汽连续吸收、光谱参数及低波数吸收对气候效应估算的影响。
doi:10.5194/acp-26-13069-2026.en: We update a fast method for calculating the global mean radiative efficiency (RE) for weak absorbers (known as the Pinnock Curve). It is then employed to evaluate improved REs, for 30 halocarbons focusing particularly on the low-wavenumber (<500 cm −1 ) contributions where laboratory measurements of absorption cross-sections are scarce.

doi:10.5194/acp-26-13139-2026.zh: 利用西藏高分辨率臭氧激光雷达、拉曼温度剖面和再分析资料，解析平流层—对流层交换中的快速臭氧下输及其与动力过程的联系。
doi:10.5194/acp-26-13139-2026.en: This study characterizes a prominent ozone intrusion event driven by stratosphere-to-troposphere exchange (STE) that occurred on 18–19 October 2017. The analysis is enabled by high spatiotemporal resolution ozone profile observations from the USTC Ozone Lidar deployed at Yangbajing, Tibet (29° N, 99° E).

doi:10.5194/acp-26-13157-2026.zh: 结合卫星降水与再分析云水资料，统计亚洲季风区中尺度对流系统的降水效率，比较云核、砧云及不同尺度和生命周期阶段的差异。
doi:10.5194/acp-26-13157-2026.en: This study investigates the precipitation efficiency ( ε ) of tropical mesoscale convective systems (MCSs) using satellite-based precipitation rates (P˙) and reanalysis cloud, ice, and liquid water paths (CWP, IWP, LWP). We define ε as the ratio of P˙ to CWP, following Li et al. (2022), and phase-partition it using IWP and LWP.

doi:10.5194/acp-26-13213-2026.zh: 利用涡动协方差观测测量低浓度含氧有机物的地表—大气交换通量，分析沉降、排放与双向交换，并评估信噪比和水汽变化对测量的影响。
doi:10.5194/acp-26-13213-2026.en: Oxygenated Organic Molecules (OOMs) represent a substantial fraction of ambient reactive carbon and are potential precursors of secondary organic aerosols (SOA). Surface-atmosphere exchange flux modulates OOM budgets and subsequent SOA formation.

doi:10.5194/acp-26-13303-2026.zh: 提出联合光声光谱与积分球测量的方法，分离黑碳、棕碳及包覆透镜效应的吸收贡献，为气溶胶吸收增强和辐射强迫提供观测约束。
doi:10.5194/acp-26-13303-2026.en: Accurately apportioning aerosol light absorption to black carbon (BC), brown carbon (BrC), and the lensing effect is crucial for constraining aerosol radiative forcing, yet existing methods often fail to resolve all three components simultaneously. Here, we introduce and demonstrate an integrated measurement framework that couples photoacoustic spectroscopy (PAX) with an integrating sphere system using solvent mediation (ISS).

doi:10.5194/acp-26-13319-2026.zh: 利用 CloudSat/CALIPSO 建立按云型区分的混合相云气候态，发现相同云顶温度下云相仍随云型和区域变化，为云参数化评估提供依据。
doi:10.5194/acp-26-13319-2026.en: Mixed-phase clouds play a critical role in Earth's radiation budget but remain a major source of uncertainty in climate models. Existing satellite climatologies mostly describe mixed-phase clouds in aggregate, without separating cloud types that differ in dynamics, vertical structure, spatial distribution, and macrophysical properties.

doi:10.5194/acp-26-13441-2026.zh: 结合全球流星雷达观测研究中间层与低热层的日潮汐，揭示太阳天顶角对潮汐垂直结构的季节调制，并讨论背景风导致的南北半球差异。
doi:10.5194/acp-26-13441-2026.en: A global climatology of diurnal tides in the mesosphere and lower thermosphere (MLT) is constructed using multiyear observations from fifteen meteor radars distributed worldwide. The results show that diurnal tidal amplitudes are strongest at low and mid-latitudes (10–50° N/S), with peak values of about 60 m s −1 near 20–30° N/S, and are comparatively weak near the Equator and at polar latitudes.

doi:10.1029/2026jd046756.zh: 对比参数化对流与允许对流的加拿大区域气候模拟，评估温带气旋路径、寿命及伴随风雨的偏差，检验更高分辨率对局地气候分析的价值。
doi:10.1029/2026jd046756.en: Abstract The ability of convection‐permitting regional climate models to realistically simulate extratropical cyclones (ETCs) and associated near‐surface wind speeds and precipitation remains poorly documented. This study provides the first comprehensive evaluation of the sixth version of the Canadian regional climate model (CRCM) for this purpose over northeastern North America.

doi:10.1029/2026jd046823.zh: 利用大集合气候模拟及高分辨率降尺度研究美国东北部未来温带气旋，分析频率、路径和强风变化，指出事件减少可能与极端气旋增强并存。
doi:10.1029/2026jd046823.en: Abstract Extratropical Cyclones (ETCs) can produce high‐impact weather in mid‐latitudes, leading to extreme precipitation, winds, and storm surges. Despite the societal and economic impacts of ETCs, gaps remain in our understanding of how ETCs and their related hazards will change in a changing climate.

doi:10.1029/2026jd047078.zh: 对比西北太平洋能否发展为热带气旋的扰动，分析 MJO、赤道罗斯贝波和开尔文波对涡度、降水和能量增长的不同调制。
doi:10.1029/2026jd047078.en: Abstract Tropical waves, including Madden−Julian Oscillation (MJO), equatorial Rossby (ER) waves, and Kelvin waves, potentially play crucial roles in the genesis of tropical cyclones (TCs). However, their influence during the precursory stage of TC genesis remains poorly understood.

doi:10.1029/2025jd045632.zh: 通过超参数化大气模式研究南亚季风的突发建立，指出爆发前浅对流及其能量输送可改变边界层湿静能梯度，促进跨赤道环流发展。
doi:10.1029/2025jd045632.en: Abstract This study investigates the effects of convection‐circulation coupling on the onset of the South Asian monsoon from a sectorial zonal‐mean perspective, using the Super‐parameterized Community Atmospheric Model (SP‐CAM), which couples Community Earth System Model version 1 (CESM1) with a cloud resolving model. The SP‐CAM simulations shows an equatorially symmetric meridional circulation during spring, representing the eddy‐driven regime, and a cross‐equatorial circulation during summer, indicating the angular momentum‐conserving regime.

doi:10.1029/2025jd045658.zh: 从湿静能收支研究南亚季风爆发的骤变程度，将爆发前浅环流的逆梯度能量输送与对流聚集联系起来，并用机制试验检验云辐射作用。
doi:10.1029/2025jd045658.en: Abstract A key challenge in understanding South Asian summer monsoon (SASM) onset is to identify how convection–circulation coupling redistributes moist static energy (MSE) before the mature cross‐equatorial monsoon circulation is established. This study aims to explain the variability of the onset abruptness of the SASM by investigating its energetics in a 20‐year simulation of the Superparameterized Community Atmospheric Model.

doi:10.1029/2025jd044824.zh: 使用 CLEPS 多相化学模型解释海洋夜间硫氮化学与新粒子形成，分析海水生物过程、气海交换及硝酸生成对观测粒子前体的影响。
doi:10.1029/2025jd044824.en: Abstract Nucleation of aerosol particles is the main source of cloud condensation nuclei over most oceans. Dimethyl sulfide (DMS) is the volatile gas released by the marine biota suspected to drive nucleation over the ocean and it is often the only marine nucleation precursor gas implemented in atmospheric models.

doi:10.1029/2026jd046332.zh: 结合观测与高分辨率模拟研究强垂直风切变下台风的快速增强，揭示非对称降水和外围暖空气侵入如何形成主导降压的中层暖心。
doi:10.1029/2026jd046332.en: Abstract Under strong environmental vertical wind shear (VWS), tropical cyclones (TCs) typically exhibit pronounced vertical tilt and precipitation asymmetry that are generally considered unfavorable for rapid intensification (RI). Nonetheless, some of these TCs still experience RI, presenting challenges for intensity forecasts.

doi:10.1029/2025jd045396.zh: 通过集合预报及多分辨率模拟研究罗斯贝波破碎，指出暖输送带的持续性和上游气旋倾斜会改变波放大过程，影响中期预报结果。
doi:10.1029/2025jd045396.en: Abstract Misrepresentation of warm‐conveyor belts (WCBs) in weather forecasting models can impinge on the medium‐range predictability of Rossby waves. Yet, the link between WCB errors and Rossby wave evolution remains poorly understood, despite the importance of Rossby wave breaking (RWB) for weather extremes.

doi:10.1029/2026jd047482.zh: 结合观测和模拟研究楚科奇海海冰减少放缓，探讨黑潮延伸体与湾流同步增暖如何通过跨海盆大气响应、海冰辐合和云辐射影响融冰。
doi:10.1029/2026jd047482.en: Abstract Although global mean surface temperatures have risen rapidly, summer sea ice loss in the Chukchi Sea has exhibited an anomalous deceleration since the early 2000s. Using observations and numerical experiments, we show that this trend deceleration is closely linked to the synchronized sea surface temperature (SST) between the Kuroshio Extension (KE) and Gulf Stream (GS), known as boundary current synchronization (BCS).

doi:10.1029/2026jd046330.zh: 分析气候模式中赤道东太平洋海温年循环偏差，利用混合层热收支和数值试验区分风驱动海洋动力过程与地表热通量反馈。
doi:10.1029/2026jd046330.en: Abstract Coupled atmosphere‐ocean models exhibit significant biases in simulating the Sea Surface Temperature (SST) annual cycle, with substantial inter‐model discrepancies. The Chinese Academy of Sciences Earth System Model (CAS‐ESM2‐0), as one of the models contributing to the Coupled Model Intercomparison Project Phase 6 (CMIP6), displays a more pronounced SST annual cycle in the eastern equatorial Pacific when compared with observations.

doi:10.1029/2026jd047391.zh: 通过允许对流的集合模拟比较日本北部两次线状对流事件，区分水汽供给和辐合强度对降水强度、输送路径和中尺度低压对雨带位置的作用。
doi:10.1029/2026jd047391.en: Abstract Line‐shaped mesoscale convective systems (MCSs) frequently produce extreme rainfall and severe hydrological disasters in Japan. This study investigates the environmental controls on both rainfall intensity and spatial displacement associated with two line‐shaped MCS events over northern Japan using convection‐permitting ensemble simulations.

doi:10.1029/2026jd047092.zh: 研究热带印度洋—西太平洋极端降水的年代际变化，将强降水减少与强上升运动减弱联系起来，强调动力变化对区域降水响应的重要性。
doi:10.1029/2026jd047092.en: Abstract Increase in extreme precipitation is expected with global warming that leads to an increase in atmospheric moisture content. Here, we present evidence for interdecadal decrease in extreme precipitation frequency and amount around 2008/2009 over the tropical Indo‐western Pacific region.

doi:10.1029/2026jd046985.zh: 利用气候化学模型研究洪阿火山水汽与二氧化硫共同注入，说明气溶胶、水汽滞留、温度、环流和臭氧之间的非线性作用不能简单相加。
doi:10.1029/2026jd046985.en: Abstract The January 2022 Hunga volcanic eruption injected an unprecedented ∼150 Tg of water vapor (O) and ∼0.4 Tg of sulfur dioxide () into the stratosphere. Observational studies confirm that this perturbation triggered significant changes in stratospheric composition and dynamics.

doi:10.1029/2026jd047277.zh: 利用高塔与风廓线观测分析登陆台风的风场和湍流，检验动量扩散参数化及相似理论在非均匀、非对称强风环境中的适用性。
doi:10.1029/2026jd047277.en: Abstract Boundary layer turbulence and vertical mixing exert great control over the structure and evolution of tropical cyclones (TCs). However, scaling and parameterizing them remains challenging due to their inherent complexity and limited observations.

doi:10.1029/2026jd046821.zh: 结合雷达与再分析资料研究青藏高原东侧和四川盆地的中尺度对流系统，比较地形、日变化环流及环境条件对系统结构和演变的影响。
doi:10.1029/2026jd046821.en: Abstract This work studies the characteristics of mesoscale convective systems (MCSs) over the eastern Tibetan Plateau (ETP) and Sichuan Basin (SB), Southwest China using radar observations in summer of 2016–2020, and their ambient conditions using the ERA5 reanalysis. A total of 171 MCSs are identified, with 76% generated in the SB while the others in the mountainous region above 1,500 m.

doi:10.1029/2026jd047124.zh: 结合锋面识别与模式试验研究气溶胶变化对中国春季锋面降水的影响，分析温度梯度和锋面频率变化如何造成南北不同的降水响应。
doi:10.1029/2026jd047124.en: Abstract Synoptic fronts are frequent weather systems over East Asia and closely associated with rainfall, especially in spring when frontal activities contribute to most of the precipitation. Aerosols have been considered as an important factor in modulating regional precipitation, and recently the pronounced decreasing trend is observed in China, which could potentially affect frontal precipitation (FP).

doi:10.1029/2026jd047841.zh: 利用 GRAINEX 观测研究灌溉对边界层及对流环境的影响，通过对流潜势、湿度和抬升凝结高度等指标，分析陆面水分对对流条件的调节。
doi:10.1029/2026jd047841.en: Abstract Land use land cover change and irrigation plays an important role in modulating weather and climate. This research uses data from a field campaign, named, the Great Plains Irrigation Experiment (GRAINEX), conducted over southeastern Nebraska, and quantifies the impacts of irrigation on bi‐hourly evolution of the convective environment.

doi:10.1029/2026jd047681.zh: 结合同位素模式与石笋记录研究 ENSO 对中国东南部降水季节性的影响，讨论季风和非季风降水比例变化如何影响氧同位素气候解释。
doi:10.1029/2026jd047681.en: Abstract Southeastern China (SEC) lies within the core region of the East Asian monsoon and exhibits pronounced hydroclimatic variability associated with the El Niño–Southern Oscillation (ENSO). Instrumental and modeling studies indicate that ENSO influences regional precipitation primarily through changes in seasonality rather than annual mean precipitation.

doi:10.1029/2026jd046721.zh: 通过集合模拟比较暖气候与工业化前背景下的大火山喷发响应，分析热带非洲降水、上升运动及水汽输送变化，揭示背景增暖对火山影响的调制。
doi:10.1029/2026jd046721.en: Abstract Volcanic eruptions are among the most abrupt natural forcings of the climate system and can induce pronounced hydroclimatic disruptions, particularly in monsoon‐influenced regions. Using a 30‐member CESM ensemble, we examine how the 1815 Tambora‐size eruption would affect precipitation across tropical Africa under both preindustrial (Tam‐1850) and moderately warmed (Tam‐RCP4.5) background climates.

doi:10.1175/jpo-d-26-0059.1.zh: 利用再分析和拉格朗日轨迹研究阿拉斯加湾输运，区分平均环流与涡旋的离岸输出及沿岸滞留，分析海洋热浪期间两类输运的变化。
doi:10.1175/jpo-d-26-0059.1.en: Abstract The Alaska subpolar gyre is a high-nutrient, low-chlorophyll system in which offshore productivity depends on exchange with iron- and macronutrient-rich coastal waters. Mesoscale eddies are the primary mechanism for export of nutrient-rich coastal waters offshore, and their formation is strongly linked to large-scale atmospheric forcing associated with the Aleutian Low (AL), which seasonally modulates regional wind stress, circulation, and eddy generation.

doi:10.1175/jpo-d-26-0037.1.zh: 利用允许次中尺度过程的海洋模拟与粗粒化诊断，研究西北太平洋动能的三维收支，揭示压力功将混合层能量向下输送并补给内部中尺度运动的路径。
doi:10.1175/jpo-d-26-0037.1.en: Abstract The oceanic energy budget across mesoscale and submesoscale plays a crucial role in regulating large-scale ocean circulation and air-sea interactions. Although submesoscale baroclinic instability is known to inject energy near the surface and fuel an inverse energy cascade toward mesoscale eddies, the vertical pathway through which this energy is redistributed remains poorly understood.

doi:10.1175/jpo-d-25-0172.1.zh: 利用冰缘区浮标资料估计海浪衰减，分析高频衰减曲线趋平或下降的现象，指出仪器噪声和局地风输入会影响海冰衰减系数的判断。
doi:10.1175/jpo-d-25-0172.1.en: Abstract Ocean surface waves propagating into the marginal ice zone influence the extent and properties of sea ice through wave–ice interactions. However, the attenuation of wave energy by sea ice remains poorly represented in wave models used for climate projections and operational forecasting, and no universally applicable parametric formulation has yet been established.

doi:10.1175/jpo-d-26-0092.1.zh: 通过高分辨率加利福尼亚海流模拟研究中尺度涡的能量来源，揭示混合层深度及再层化的季节变化如何改变跨尺度能量传递的主导路径。
doi:10.1175/jpo-d-26-0092.1.en: Abstract Mesoscale eddies are the dominant reservoir of kinetic energy in the ocean, yet the mechanisms that generate and maintain them in eastern boundary current systems remain incompletely assessed. Here we use a 1-km resolution simulation of the California Current System (CCS) to diagnose and quantify the processes that supply kinetic energy to the mesoscale band.

doi:10.1175/jpo-d-26-0081.1.zh: 利用高分辨率模拟比较黑潮沿程不同地形约束下的动力状态，分析非地转压力功、剪切与应变对能量维持、流轴迁移和涡旋作用的影响。
doi:10.1175/jpo-d-26-0081.1.en: Abstract Using a validated, high-resolution simulation (CMOMS), we quantify the topographically-modulated dynamics and energetic paths of the Kuroshio to characterize its along-stream heterogeneous variability and connectivity. Based on a dynamically consistent 3D jet stream definition, our analysis reveals two dynamically distinct regimes governed by the degree of topographic constraint on the Kuroshio’s structure and variability.

doi:10.1175/jcli-d-25-0688.1.zh: 在固定海温条件下比较不同复杂度模式，研究平流层气溶胶的直接辐射影响；上对流层加热可改变云与对流，降水响应还受云辐射反馈调节。
doi:10.1175/jcli-d-25-0688.1.en: Abstract A concern for stratospheric aerosol injection (SAI) is that stratospheric aerosols could inadvertently alter rain and winds through mechanisms independent of the intended surface cooling. Here, we investigate how the tropical troposphere responds to SAI in models of different complexity, including convection-resolving mock-Walker and small-domain simulations as well as a global climate model, with sea surface temperature held fixed.

doi:10.1175/jcli-d-25-0605.1.zh: 区分极端与非极端降水对华南夏季降水年代际增加的贡献，发现降水事件频率变化尤为重要，并将其与季风及热带气旋活动变化联系起来。
doi:10.1175/jcli-d-25-0605.1.en: Abstract A pronounced interdecadal increase in summer (June–August) precipitation over southern China has been evident around 1993. Yet, the relative contributions of extreme precipitation (EP) and non-EP to this increase and the physical drivers remain poorly understood, despite their critical implications for water resource management and disaster preparedness.

doi:10.1175/jcli-d-25-0549.1.zh: 在随机气候模型和北大西洋观测中比较三种海温强迫估计方法，重点检验海洋强迫具有红噪声特征时的偏差与低频适用性。
doi:10.1175/jcli-d-25-0549.1.en: Abstract This paper compares three methods for quantifying stochastic ocean forcing to low-frequency sea surface temperature (SST) variability from the surface heat budget in the framework of a simple stochastic climate model, especially in the case of red noise ocean forcing. The three methods are PT21 (Patrizio and Thompson), PT22 (Patrizio and Thompson), and LGD23 (Liu et al.).

doi:10.1175/jcli-d-25-0568.1.zh: 通过代用资料同化与气候模拟器重建过去千年的大气顶辐射，区分长短波贡献，分析工业化前降温、火山活动及现代能量积累的关系。
doi:10.1175/jcli-d-25-0568.1.en: Abstract Earth’s energy imbalance at the top of the atmosphere is a key climate system metric, but its natural variability is poorly constrained by the short observational record and large uncertainty in coupled climate models. While existing ocean heat content reconstructions offer a longer perspective, they cannot separate the contributions of shortwave and longwave radiation, obscuring the underlying processes.

doi:10.1175/jcli-d-25-0668.1.zh: 利用再分析研究中国夏季极端阵风的长期变化，分析华南与西北不同的低压、斜压性及罗斯贝波配置如何影响强阵风发生。
doi:10.1175/jcli-d-25-0668.1.en: Abstract Wind gusts—rapid surges in wind speed occurring within minutes or even seconds—pose significant risks to aviation, infrastructure, and human safety. Yet, the changes in extreme wind gusts (EWGs) across China remain poorly understood.

doi:10.1175/jcli-d-25-0674.1.zh: 研究印度洋偶极子对孟加拉湾南部西南季风流轴的年际调节，将 Gill 型大气响应、局地风应力旋度和远程海洋波动联系起来。
doi:10.1175/jcli-d-25-0674.1.en: Abstract The Southwest Monsoon Current (SMC) flowing from the Arabian Sea (AS) into the Bay of Bengal (BoB), driven by the summer monsoon, can significantly affect the thermohaline structure of the BoB and further influence summer monsoon variability through air–sea interaction. The SMC exhibited significant interannual variability, especially in its axis position during 1993–2022.

doi:10.1175/jcli-d-26-0171.1.zh: 研究东北太平洋远洋热带气旋活动与厄尔尼诺空间类型的关系，分析气旋对低层风、沃克环流和温跃层梯度的调节及相应海温反馈。
doi:10.1175/jcli-d-26-0171.1.en: Abstract Pelagic tropical cyclones (TCs) over the Northeast Pacific (ENP) do not make landfall, so they have not been paid enough attention. This study explores the impact of these tropical cyclones (TCs) on El Niño diversity, based on both traditional and new classifications of El Niño spatial patterns using accumulated cyclone energy (ACE).

doi:10.1175/jcli-d-26-0076.1.zh: 结合卫星高度计与气候模式研究南大洋海平面变化的经向带状结构，区分太平洋年代际变率与外部强迫对不同海盆响应的作用。
doi:10.1175/jcli-d-26-0076.1.en: Abstract Satellite altimetry (1993–2024) reveals that the Southern Ocean dynamic sea level (DSL) exhibits a distinct belt-like pattern, with smaller rises south of 50°S and larger rises to the north. This zonal belt is not uniform but strongly asymmetric, with the largest DSL increase in the Pacific sector and weaker changes in the Atlantic and Indian sectors.

doi:10.1175/jcli-d-26-0127.1.zh: 利用两套全球海洋资料比较多类模态水的温度变化，通过热收支区分内部平流输送与混合层水团转化，并讨论主导过程的时间尺度依赖。
doi:10.1175/jcli-d-26-0127.1.en: Abstract Mode waters, characterized by vertically uniform temperature and salinity beneath the mixed layer, play a crucial role in ventilating anthropogenic heat and carbon into the ocean interior. However, the global comparison of their temperature evolution and governing processes under a global closed-budget framework remains to become more systematically undertaken, as required to make mechanistic progress.

doi:10.1175/jcli-d-25-0487.1.zh: 比较 CMIP6 模式并开展区域强迫试验，分析拉布拉多海热通量与盐输送反馈如何影响大西洋翻转环流减弱及模式间差异。
doi:10.1175/jcli-d-25-0487.1.en: Abstract Future Atlantic Meridional Overturning Circulation (AMOC) weakening remains a robust but poorly understood projection, with substantial uncertainty in the underlying regional mechanisms and inter-model spread. This study analyzes 30 Coupled Model Intercomparison Project Phase 6 (CMIP6) models to identify regional surface-forcing sensitivities associated with the inter-model spread of AMOC weakening.

doi:10.1175/jcli-d-26-0128.1.zh: 结合观测与百成员大气模式集合，分离海温强迫和大气内部变率对西北太平洋热带气旋生成纬度的贡献，并探索季节预测指标。
doi:10.1175/jcli-d-26-0128.1.en: Abstract Tropical cyclone (TC) genesis latitude in the northwest Pacific (NWP) exhibits strong year-to-year variations. Combining observations with a 100-member ensemble of TC-permitting atmospheric model simulations, we examine the oceanic forcing and atmospheric internal variability in these variations.

doi:10.1175/jcli-d-25-0575.1.zh: 区分 ENSO 及独立海温前兆对海河流域夏季降水的作用，分析北太平洋—北大西洋信号的年代际变化，并构建具有物理依据的季节预测。
doi:10.1175/jcli-d-25-0575.1.en: Abstract Escalating flood risks highlight the need for a better understanding of the predictability of Haihe River Basin summer precipitation (HRBSP). Here, we investigate the distinct roles of ENSO-related and ENSO-independent sea surface temperature (SST) precursors in modulating interannual HRBSP variability.

doi:10.1175/jcli-d-26-0222.1.zh: 利用气候模式研究中高纬陆地春季增暖相对偏弱的原因，将有效大气热容量、下行长波和土壤水分引起的蒸发变化联系起来。
doi:10.1175/jcli-d-26-0222.1.en: Abstract Global land, especially over mid-to-high latitude, exhibits a pronounced temperature annual cycle. How this annual cycle would change in a warming climate has great impacts on the climate system and ecosystems, but largely remains unknown.

doi:10.1175/jcli-d-25-0593.1.zh: 提出基于地表能量收支的解析模型，估计极暖气候下全球平均降水的上限，解释水汽增强短波吸收为何可能使进一步增暖伴随降水减少。
doi:10.1175/jcli-d-25-0593.1.en: Abstract Earth’s climate has experienced periods of extreme warmth known as hothouse climates. In these states, surface evaporation is almost entirely balanced by absorbed shortwave radiation.

doi:10.1175/jcli-d-26-0259.1.zh: 将 ENSO 充放电振子扩展为空间偏微分方程模型，通过稳定性与响应分析研究盆地尺度模态，提出历史 ENSO 可表现为接近临界的受迫响应。
doi:10.1175/jcli-d-26-0259.1.en: Abstract The recharge oscillator (RO) captures the core ENSO feedback loop in two physically transparent equations but collapses the basin into lumped variables, whereas coupled models of intermediate and higher complexity resolve spatial structure at the cost of less direct operator-level attribution. Here we recast the RO as a spatially explicit strip model: a minimal three-field linear partial differential equation (PDE) framework, evolved directly from RO dynamics, that retains identifiable states and operators (eastern-Pacific SST, western recharge memory, and eastern thermocline adjustment) while resolving basin-scale spatial modes.

doi:10.1175/jcli-d-25-0570.1.zh: 利用允许热带气旋的全球模式研究暖海温下风暴增强，区分潜在强度上升与实际强度接近该上限的效率变化，强调风暴尺度辐射反馈的作用。
doi:10.1175/jcli-d-25-0570.1.en: Abstract Tropical cyclones (TCs) are expected to intensify in a warming climate as sea surface temperatures (SSTs) rise. Potential intensity (PI), the thermodynamic upper limit on storm strength, has long been used to assess how environmental conditions constrain TC intensity.

doi:10.1175/jcli-d-26-0461.1.zh: 比较乌拉尔阻塞后长江流域偏湿和偏干事件，分析罗斯贝波演变、热带背景及西北太平洋环流共同配置如何控制水汽输送与降水。
doi:10.1175/jcli-d-26-0461.1.en: Abstract Ural blocking (UB) generally induces wintertime cooling over the Yangtze River basin (YRB), but the precipitation response varies among events. This study investigates the circulation processes underlying wet and dry YRB responses to UB events during 1979–2020.

doi:10.1175/jcli-d-26-0211.1.zh: 识别 ENSO 对次年夏季西北太平洋反气旋影响的年代际变化，区分反气旋强度和空间形态变化，并分析不同热带海温遥相关路径。
doi:10.1175/jcli-d-26-0211.1.en: Abstract El Niño–Southern Oscillation (ENSO) events which usually mature during winter can have significant impacts on subsequent summertime western North Pacific anticyclone (WNPAC) and associated East Asian rainfall. Such delayed impacts are known to undergo interdecadal changes, but a systematic investigation on the characteristics of these interdecadal changes and underlying mechanisms remains lacking.

doi:10.1175/jcli-d-26-0235.1.zh: 通过区域海温扰动试验比较不同海盆对撒哈拉近地面温度的影响，揭示地中海、加勒比海和北印度洋通过环流与水平热平流产生不同响应。
doi:10.1175/jcli-d-26-0235.1.en: Abstract The Sahara Desert has undergone substantial near-surface warming during the boreal warm season (June–November) in recent decades. Previous studies have suggested that historical and future Saharan warming is largely controlled by sea surface temperature (SST) changes.

doi:10.1175/jcli-d-25-0459.1.zh: 利用土壤湿度扰动集合试验研究美国西南部春季干燥的远程影响，分析陆面加热激发的环流异常及后续水汽、云量减少如何促进西部初夏增暖。
doi:10.1175/jcli-d-25-0459.1.en: Abstract A prior study observed that regional variations in springtime soil moisture over the American Southwest are associated with distal summertime temperature and precipitation anomalies across the Western United States. Here, we perform an ensemble of soil moisture depletion experiments within the Community Earth System Model (CESM2) and show that a reduction in March surface soil moisture over the Southwest US causes positive May–June temperature anomalies throughout the Western US and precipitation anomalies in the Northwest that are consistent with observations.

doi:10.1175/jcli-d-25-0422.1.zh: 结合再分析与卫星资料研究 MJO 与北太平洋温带主要变率模态的季节联系，通过罗斯贝波源分析解释热带遥相关强弱的季节差异。
doi:10.1175/jcli-d-25-0422.1.en: Abstract The Madden Julian Oscillation (MJO) is a tropical, intraseasonal phenomenon that generates teleconnections like the Pacific North American pattern in boreal winter, but knowledge about MJO teleconnections in other seasons is limited. To expand the knowledge of MJO teleconnections in all seasons, we investigate whether the MJO is tied to any leading extratropical modes in the Northern Hemisphere Pacific basin using reanalysis and satellite data.

doi:10.1007/s00382-026-08372-0.zh: 从扰动位能诊断广东 2024 年 4 月极端降水，分析东欧热异常维持的波列如何调节急流、热平流与局地能量转换，建立远程高温与持续降水的动力联系。
doi:10.1007/s00382-026-08372-0.en: An energetic diagnosis links eastern European heat anomalies to Guangdong rainfall through a sustained wave train and local energy conversion.

doi:10.1007/s00382-026-08334-6.zh: 结合 CMIP6 与高分辨率观测，以概率比和非线性标度评估中国极端降水归因，发现人为影响一般随事件稀有程度增强，但存在区域差异与不确定性。
doi:10.1007/s00382-026-08334-6.en: Model simulations and observations are combined to evaluate how anthropogenic influence varies with the rarity of precipitation extremes.

doi:10.1007/s00382-026-08324-8.zh: 联合逐日同位素观测、水汽轨迹和瑞利分馏模拟，区分季风前局地再循环与云下蒸发、季风期上游雨除及季风后输送变化对高原东南部降水同位素的控制。
doi:10.1007/s00382-026-08324-8.en: Isotope observations and moisture modelling reveal seasonal shifts among recycling, upstream rainout, and sub-cloud evaporation.

doi:10.1007/s00382-026-08378-8.zh: 用统一极值理论分析全球陆地长期年降水异常，在同一概率框架下比较极湿和极干事件的强度、频率与空间变化，揭示不同气候区的响应差异。
doi:10.1007/s00382-026-08378-8.en: A unified extreme-value framework tracks the changing intensity, frequency, and geography of annual wet and dry precipitation anomalies.

doi:10.1007/s00382-026-08382-y.zh: 构建亚马孙复合水文气候极端指数，联合分析降水、温度和河流水位，研究海温、季节背景及陆气反馈对干热和湿冷状态的调制。
doi:10.1007/s00382-026-08382-y.en: Abstract Over recent decades Amazonia has experienced a marked intensification of floods and droughts. The record-breaking 2023–2024 drought, characterized by exceptional heat and dryness, motivates a closer analysis of compound extremes and their large-scale drivers.

doi:10.1007/s00382-026-08385-9.zh: 比较多模式未来洋流输运和位置变化，分析副热带环流迁移与风强迫的作用，指出不同海盆和西边界流的变化及驱动机制并不一致。
doi:10.1007/s00382-026-08385-9.en: Abstract While climate change scenarios consistently project future changes in ocean circulation, an inter-basin assessment of the extent, intensity and underlying mechanisms driving these changes is still needed. Therefore, this study quantifies alterations in ocean currents’ volume transport (VT) and assess their relationship with subtropical gyre branch displacements and wind forcing changes based on projections from the Coupled Model Intercomparison Project Phase 6.

doi:10.1007/s00382-026-08360-4.zh: 通过里海水量收支研究大尺度环流影响，指出伏尔加河入流是重要变化来源，并用动态回归及卡尔曼滤波联系大气环流指数与水位重建。
doi:10.1007/s00382-026-08360-4.en: A water-budget analysis links Caspian level variability to Volga discharge and large-scale atmospheric circulation indices.

doi:10.1007/s00382-026-08393-9.zh: 利用 ERA5 低层风场识别南美副热带七类环流型，统一诊断逐日到长期变化，连接低空急流、辐合带及 ENSO 等模态与区域降水异常和趋势。
doi:10.1007/s00382-026-08393-9.en: Seven low-level circulation patterns link weather variability and climate teleconnections to subtropical South American rainfall.

doi:10.1007/s00382-026-08380-0.zh: 通过扰动云和对流参数的耦合集合，分离季风降水预估中的增暖幅度与降水敏感度贡献，指出低云形成阈值和对流降水蒸发参数具有不同影响路径。
doi:10.1007/s00382-026-08380-0.en: Perturbed-parameter simulations separate warming amplitude from precipitation sensitivity in projections of global monsoon rainfall.

doi:10.5194/cp-22-1675-2026.zh: 利用格陵兰冰芯比较冰期末大气总铁沉降与生物可利用铁的变化，说明粉尘铁增加不必等比例转化为海洋可利用铁，影响古生产力解释。
doi:10.5194/cp-22-1675-2026.en: Iron (Fe) availability modulates phytoplankton blooms in High-Nutrient Low-Chlorophyll (HNLC) regions, i.e., ocean areas characterized by an abundance of major nutrients but low marine productivity. Fe can be delivered to the oceans through atmospheric dust deposition, making ice cores unique archives for reconstructing past changes in aeolian Fe deposition.

doi:10.5194/cp-22-1691-2026.zh: 利用孟加拉湾沉积物花粉记录重建 MIS 11 期间印度植被与夏季风变化，区分日照、二氧化碳、冰量及千年尺度变率在不同阶段的作用。
doi:10.5194/cp-22-1691-2026.en: Marine Isotope Stage (MIS) 11 has long been considered a unique Quaternary interglacial stage due to its orbital similarities with the Holocene, persistent high atmospheric CO 2 concentrations and its extended duration, which triggered an unusual polar ice-sheet loss. Despite its importance, variability of the Asian summer monsoon, as well as its impacts on vulnerable tropical forests, during MIS 11 remain unexplored.

doi:10.5194/cp-22-1711-2026.zh: 结合朝鲜半岛石笋氧同位素与同位素气候模拟，解释轨道尺度季风信号为何偏弱，指出海洋和陆地水汽来源的贡献可相互抵消。
doi:10.5194/cp-22-1711-2026.en: A recent study identified an east-west dipole pattern in Asian Summer Monsoon precipitation and in its oxygen-isotope composition variability in response to orbital forcing (Wen et al., 2024). The Korean Peninsula (KP) is situated near the nodal line of this dipole and should therefore exhibit muted precessional variability in both.

doi:10.1002/qj.70317.zh: 提出考虑云相的全天空红外辐射偏差订正，用模式与观测的云顶温差构造非线性预测因子，并在韩国暴雨个例中检验资料同化与短期预报改进。
doi:10.1002/qj.70317.en: Abstract Infrared (IR) radiances are highly sensitive to cloud top properties, making all‐sky data assimilation (DA) challenging due to scene‐dependent biases arising from uncertainties in cloud representation and radiative transfer modeling. This study introduces a phase‐aware nonlinear bias correction (BC) framework for all‐sky IR radiances.

doi:10.1002/qj.70308.zh: 识别喜马拉雅极端降水的季节分布和典型天气型，比较季风低压、西风扰动及其相互作用，为理解不同分区的强降水前兆提供框架。
doi:10.1002/qj.70308.en: Abstract Extreme precipitation events (EPEs) in the Western Himalayas (WH) have significant cross‐sector impacts, yet understanding of their seasonal characteristics and synoptic drivers remains inadequate. This study presents an analysis of EPEs across the full annual cycle of the Himalayas from 1979 to 2023, identifying their spatial and seasonal distributions and associated precursor weather regimes.

doi:10.1002/qj.70313.zh: 评估四个副热带辐合区云带的次季节预测能力，区分时间错位和环流误差，指出改进中尺度对流组织对利用潜在可预报性的重要性。
doi:10.1002/qj.70313.en: Abstract Tropical–extratropical cloud bands act as a primary source of moisture and precipitation for the subtropics, yet their representation and predictability on subseasonal time‐scales remain challenging. This study evaluates the subseasonal predictive skill of these cloud bands up to four weeks within the European Centre for Medium‐Range Weather Forecasts (ECMWF) reforecasts from 2003 to 2022 across the four main subtropical convergence zones.

doi:10.1177/15311074261484864.zh: 总结地外生命探测中非生物背景的挑战，讨论非生物物质与过程如何模仿、遮蔽或改变生物标志，并联系海洋世界任务的仪器选择与数据解释。
doi:10.1177/15311074261484864.en: The “Exploring the Abiotic Background for Life Detection” workshop was convened between March 31, 2025, and April 3, 2025, at the Carnegie Institution for Science in Washington, D.C. The workshop gathered scientists and technologists from different disciplines and career stages to consider the “abiotic background”: recognizing, characterizing, and understanding the set of abiotic substances, structures, and processes that may result in potential false-positive or false-negative results in the search for evidence of life beyond Earth.

doi:10.1029/2025gl120661.zh: 利用 BGC-Argo 后向散射资料识别全球中层海洋粒子薄层，研究其分布、碳储量及与缺氧区和俯冲的联系，检验粒子浓度随深度单调下降的假设。
doi:10.1029/2025gl120661.en: Abstract Particulate organic carbon transported to the deep ocean forms a critical component of the Earth's carbon cycle. The concentration of these particles is generally parameterized in models to decrease continuously with depth, but isolated layers of small particles (20 ) observed within the mesopelagic challenge this assumption.

doi:10.1029/2026gl123056.zh: 将随机凝结模型扩展为具有相关时间的饱和度—液滴耦合系统，并用信息流分析因果影响，解释湍流湿度记忆如何调节滴谱展宽。
doi:10.1029/2026gl123056.en: Abstract Water vapor concentration in turbulent clouds fluctuates over a wide range of scales, challenging physical understanding of droplet growth mechanisms, prediction of droplet size distributions, and attribution of causal connections. We generalize a minimalist Brownian‐motion model (McGraw & Liu, 2006, https://doi.org/10.1029/2005gl023545 ), valid only under strongly damped fluctuations, to a coupled stochastic system where the saturation ratio follows an Ornstein‐Uhlenbeck process.

doi:10.1029/2026gl122158.zh: 比较 CMIP5 与 CMIP6 北大西洋增暖格局，将热带辐合带平均位置偏差与淡水通量、翻转环流及海气热输送联系起来，尝试约束预估差异。
doi:10.1029/2026gl122158.en: Abstract The North Atlantic Subpolar Gyre (NASG) has warmed much less than the global ocean over recent decades, thereby suggesting a human‐caused slowdown of the Atlantic Meridional Overturning Circulation (AMOC). This North Atlantic “warming hole” is also found in climate projections, yet with a model‐dependent timing, location and intensity.

doi:10.1029/2026gl124627.zh: 联合卫星观测检验合声波与高能电子微暴沉降的时空对应，发现只有部分合声波伴随相对论电子损失，约束波粒相互作用的有效条件。
doi:10.1029/2026gl124627.en: Abstract Microbursts are thought to be a key contributor to radiation belt electron loss, with chorus waves considered a primary driver of this precipitation. However, the conditions under which chorus waves produce MeV electron loss remain poorly constrained.

doi:10.1029/2026gl122626.zh: 利用 SWOT 水位观测识别流域水库的季节调度模式，并结合机器学习推断主要功能，展示卫星资料对缺测流域人为水循环变化的约束能力。
doi:10.1029/2026gl122626.en: Abstract The construction and operation of reservoirs have fundamentally modified the natural hydrograph globally. However, complex seasonal operating patterns remain opaque due to data scarcity, limiting the accuracy of hydrological modeling and water management.

doi:10.1029/2026gl124347.zh: 通过耦合模式及分层试验比较二氧化碳增加和移除阶段的辐射反馈，分析翻转环流超调、北大西洋海温与低云对温度滞后的共同作用。
doi:10.1029/2026gl124347.en: Abstract Recent studies show that global mean surface temperature exhibits a transient hysteresis during removal, where temperatures remain elevated after concentrations return to pre‐industrial levels. This is largely attributed to ocean thermal inertia rather than an irreversible climate response; however, the role of radiative feedbacks remains unclear.

doi:10.1029/2026gl124267.zh: 利用长期卫星观测研究西非沙尘光学厚度日变化的演变，将午后相对增强与夜间低空急流及地表风日变化的调整联系起来。
doi:10.1029/2026gl124267.en: Abstract West Africa is the largest global source of mineral dust, with significant impacts on climate, air quality, and biogeochemical cycles. While temporal variations in dust loading from daily to interannual scales are well studied, the long‐term evolution of the diurnal cycle itself is often overlooked.

doi:10.1029/2026gl123729.zh: 联合体波和面波成像研究中美洲俯冲带结构，分析板片下低速异常、地幔流动和局部熔融如何与大地震及弧火山的沿程分段对应。
doi:10.1029/2026gl123729.en: Abstract The mechanisms underlying the patchy distribution of forearc megathrust earthquakes and arc volcanoes in subduction zones remain poorly understood. Here we present a high‐resolution seismic tomographic model of the Central American subduction zone, derived from a joint inversion of local body‐wave and teleseismic Rayleigh‐wave data.

doi:10.1029/2026gl123871.zh: 通过同时改变水平与垂直网格的全球模拟，研究尺度间动能交换，发现垂直分辨率可明显改变中尺度谱及其与天气尺度罗斯贝波结构的联系。
doi:10.1029/2026gl123871.en: Abstract Global kilometer‐scale model simulations have demonstrated clear benefits from refining horizontal resolution in representing mesoscale weather phenomena, yet the role of vertical resolution remains comparatively underexplored. To address this gap, 40‐day experiments with the model for prediction across scales systematically varied both horizontal and vertical grid spacing.

doi:10.1029/2026gl122097.zh: 利用长期海温和叶绿素卫星资料识别东边界上升流区的离岸丝状结构，估计其横向有机碳输运及季节变化，为跨陆架碳交换提供观测约束。
doi:10.1029/2026gl122097.en: Abstract Cross‐shelf interactions and the associated lateral transport of organic carbon remain poorly quantified and constrained by observations, despite their importance for the ocean carbon cycle. Filaments generated by instabilities of coastal currents are one pathway for this exchange, but their transport is difficult to observe at basin scales.

doi:10.1029/2026gl123346.zh: 耦合波粒相互作用、电子沉降和电离层化学模型，研究合声波诱发微暴对电离层密度及极光的影响，比较不同高度和辐射通道的响应时间。
doi:10.1029/2026gl123346.en: Abstract Electron microbursts are short‐lived but intense electron precipitation and constitute a significant source of electron losses into the ionosphere and lower atmosphere. They are primarily produced by wave‐particle interaction with chorus waves in the magnetosphere.

doi:10.1029/2026gl124086.zh: 利用 CMIP6 集合分析气溶胶强迫的北大西洋海温变率如何调节历史全球增暖，指出区域强迫差异可造成独立于气候敏感度的模拟偏差。
doi:10.1029/2026gl124086.en: Abstract Climate models with identical anthropogenic forcings simulate different historical warming, mainly because aerosol forcing is poorly constrained. The role of uncertainty in regional aerosol forcing, however, has not been systematically studied.

doi:10.1029/2026gl123505.zh: 通过对上游区域施加真实状态约束，利用 GraphCast 诊断极端天气预报误差的传播，探索 AI 天气模式在遥相关与动力机制研究中的用途。
doi:10.1029/2026gl123505.en: Abstract Artificial intelligence (AI) weather models can generate fast and accurate weather forecasts, yet they still struggle to predict regional extremes. Exploring error propagation pathways and associated large‐scale dynamics is essential for understanding extreme weather drivers and AI model performance.

doi:10.1029/2026gl122910.zh: 模拟强空间天气期间水星表面的离子溅射，揭示增强的粒子通量和磁层变化如何重组钙、镁外逸层及其主要释放机制。
doi:10.1029/2026gl122910.en: Abstract Mercury is exposed to various space weathering processes, which alter the surface and cause emission of atoms and molecules into the exosphere. The exosphere thus allows remote insights into the surface composition and erosion processes, with the emission of refractory elements such as Ca and Mg typically being dominated by micrometeoroid‐impact vaporization.

doi:10.1029/2026gl123330.zh: 从全球资料比较大气河的多套分类，联系振荡频率、水汽与风贡献以及温带气旋关联，识别风驱动、气旋伴随型的共同特征。
doi:10.1029/2026gl123330.en: Abstract Atmospheric rivers (ARs) are essential yet hazardous components of the global water cycle. Despite the development of multiple classification frameworks, their interconnections remain unexplored.

doi:10.1029/2026gl122833.zh: 结合 GNSS 与降阶摩擦模型研究卡斯卡迪亚慢滑移分段，区分有效正应力和板块耦合对重复周期、滑移矩及长期滑移亏损的控制。
doi:10.1029/2026gl122833.en: Abstract Slow slip events (SSEs) in the Cascadia subduction zone exhibit along‐strike segmentation, where the central segment has longer recurrence intervals but smaller moments. We quantify the controls on this variability by combining geodetic inter‐SSE coupling inversion with Bayesian inference of a quasi‐dynamic rate‐and‐state friction SSE‐cycle model accelerated by reduced‐order modeling.

doi:10.1029/2025gl120999.zh: 通过高压部分熔融与熔体—橄榄岩反应实验，研究异剥钙榴岩如何向地幔源区提供富钙组分，解释不同构造环境中的超富钙岩浆。
doi:10.1029/2025gl120999.en: Abstract Rodingite is a high‐CaO rock formed by Ca‐rich fluid metasomatism on mafic protoliths. It typically occurs within serpentinite and represents an often‐overlooked constituent of the altered oceanic lithosphere that may be subducted into the mantle.

doi:10.1029/2026gl124294.zh: 将阿拉斯加沿海浅层滑坡记录与大气河资料结合，分析极端降水、坡向和坡度的共同作用，讨论迎风地形对滑坡空间分布的影响。
doi:10.1029/2026gl124294.en: Abstract Rapid, shallow landslides in coastal mountains are triggered by extreme precipitation, shaping topography and impacting human settlements. Using an inventory of >700 landslides mapped from satellite imagery (2009–2024) and an atmospheric river database (1981–2019), this study documents linkages between climatic drivers and the topographic context of landslides on Prince of Wales Island, Southeast Alaska.

doi:10.1029/2026gl124081.zh: 联合海洋沉积物铪、钕同位素追踪风化变化，识别南极冰川研磨增强信号，为始新世—渐新世转折时期冰川起始及先导事件提供年代约束。
doi:10.1029/2026gl124081.en: Abstract The drawdown of atmospheric CO 2 likely triggered Antarctic glaciation during the Eocene‐Oligocene Transition (34 Ma). Accurately constraining this shift from “greenhouse” to an “icehouse” climate is essential for understanding global carbon cycle dynamics.

doi:10.1029/2026gl122293.zh: 利用自然海况下的立体影像测量大量破碎波，比较破碎长度、高度和速度的关系，指出几何标度随海况变化，简单自相似描述适用有限。
doi:10.1029/2026gl122293.en: Abstract Wave breaking geometry is critical for understanding air‐sea interactions, yet its characterization in the field remains limited. This study analyzes the geometry of 16,369 active breaking waves, measured via stereo imagery in the Black Sea under diverse conditions.

doi:10.1029/2026gl122396.zh: 利用 GRACE 系列观测估计加州中央谷地地下水净补给，并与降水和积雪水当量比较，发现正补给主要集中在山地积雪高于平均水平的年份。
doi:10.1029/2026gl122396.en: Abstract In a new application of GRACE and GRACE‐FO satellite observations, we estimate basin‐scale net groundwater recharge rates for the combined Sacramento, San Joaquin, and Tulare basins encompassing California's Central Valley aquifer. Net recharge is calculated as the temporal derivative of groundwater storage anomalies and compared with precipitation and snow water equivalent over a fixed study area.

doi:10.1029/2026gl122329.zh: 提出以条件流匹配生成降水序列的热带气旋临近预报模型，引入数值预报风场约束，同时描述雨带位移与强度演变，并检验跨海盆表现。
doi:10.1029/2026gl122329.en: Abstract Tropical cyclones (TCs) making landfall often produce extreme precipitation with complex spatiotemporal patterns, posing major challenges to both deep learning models and numerical weather prediction (NWP) systems. This study introduces Rainflow, a conditional flow matching (CFM) based generative model for high‐resolution TC precipitation nowcasting.

doi:10.1029/2026gl125935.zh: 利用气候模式脉冲试验研究飞机尾迹卷云形成后的水分调整，区分冰晶沉降与再增湿时间尺度，分析沉降强度对有效辐射强迫的影响。
doi:10.1029/2026gl125935.en: Abstract Condensation trails (contrails) that evolve into contrail cirrus may constitute the largest contribution to aviation's climate impact. However the strength and timescales of the adjustments of the upper atmospheric water budget to contrail formation are poorly known.

doi:10.1029/2026gl124877.zh: 整合东南亚长期灾害报告与降水资料，建立区域事件数据库，比较灾害类型和空间暴露，并指出报告完整度变化会影响长期趋势解释。
doi:10.1029/2026gl124877.en: Abstract Frequent pluvial hydrometeorological disasters in Southeast Asia (SEA) threaten lives and property, yet the region lacks a unified disaster data set for risk management and research. This study develops a provincial‐level data set integrating multi‐source hazard reports with precipitation data and identifies empirical rainfall reference values associated with reported disaster occurrences to inform early‐warning applications.

doi:10.1029/2026gl123945.zh: 利用西藏中部浅海化石及锶、氧、碳同位素重建白垩纪海洋环境，研究高原早期抬升前生态系统对温室气候及海洋事件的响应。
doi:10.1029/2026gl123945.en: Abstract The uplift of the Tibetan Plateau profoundly influences global atmospheric circulation, sediment transport, and biodiversity, but its pre‐uplift marine paleoenvironment remains poorly understood. Here we report the first discovery of an in situ benthic fossil assemblage from the Puga area in central Tibet, which was deposited on a shallow‐marine carbonate platform during the late Cenomanian.

doi:10.1029/2026gl122470.zh: 将渐进分析更新引入四维变分同化，改善台风初始化平衡；通过个例检验副热带高压、非对称结构及引导气流对快速增强和突然转向预报的影响。
doi:10.1029/2026gl122470.en: Abstract Dynamic imbalances in model initialization severely constrain the predictability of the rapid intensification (RI) and abrupt track recurvature of tropical cyclones (TCs). In this study, the effectiveness of an incremental analysis update (IAU)‐based four‐dimensional variational (4DVar) data assimilation scheme in forecasting Typhoons Doksuri and Khanun in 2023 was investigated.

doi:10.1029/2026gl122610.zh: 将 SWOT 水面高程同化到俄亥俄河流域水动力模型，检验沿河网局地化与质量控制，分析观测约束如何传播到没有直接卫星覆盖的河段。
doi:10.1029/2026gl122610.en: Abstract Surface Water and Ocean Topography (SWOT) provides water surface elevation (WSE) that can constrain river hydraulics through data assimilation (DA), but basin‐scale impacts of assimilating real observations remain uncertain under heterogeneous availability and regulation. We assimilate node‐level SWOT WSE into a large‐scale hydrodynamic model over the Ohio River Basin using an ensemble Kalman filter and test river‐network‐aware localization.

doi:10.1029/2026gl123975.zh: 统计美国不同强度大气河与锋面、低压和中尺度对流系统的共同出现，揭示复合天气配置随地区和季节改变，并联系极端降水。
doi:10.1029/2026gl123975.en: Abstract Atmospheric Rivers (ARs) often co‐occur with other weather systems, including fronts, low‐pressure systems (LPSs), and mesoscale convective systems (MCSs), which can amplify precipitation and flood risk. While extreme rainfall is frequently linked to multiple interacting features, how these systems co‐occur with AR intensity scales and regions remains unclear.

doi:10.1029/2026gl123799.zh: 通过高分辨率模拟与水汽追踪研究伊比利亚近期强大气河，比较其水汽输送和降水与高排放情景早期响应的相似性，分析槽脊及远程水汽来源。
doi:10.1029/2026gl123799.en: Abstract Atmospheric rivers (ARs) drive winter hydroclimate extremes over the Iberian Peninsula (IP). This study evaluates whether exceptional landfalling ARs (LARs) between October 2025 and February 2026 displayed characteristics expected under early high‐emission forcing.

doi:10.1029/2026gl124551.zh: 模拟导管内闪电哨声波对高能电子的散射，解释周期性微暴包的不同形态，并指出连续背景分量可能导致观测处理低估电子沉降。
doi:10.1029/2026gl124551.en: Abstract Bouncing packets are quasi‐periodic microbursts separated by the electron bounce period. Solar Anomalous and Magnetospheric Particle Explorer observations revealed relativistic (>1 MeV) inner‐belt bouncing packets with “crown,” “decaying,” and “flat” envelopes.

doi:10.1029/2026gl124943.zh: 构建考虑内部变率和系统记忆的统计模拟器，估计北极夏季海冰对排放与增暖的观测敏感度，并量化不确定性及未来首次近无冰状态的范围。
doi:10.1029/2026gl124943.en: Abstract The observed sensitivity of the Arctic summer sea‐ice area (SIA) to changes in the external forcing is a key quantity for understanding and projecting sea‐ice loss. Here, we estimate this sensitivity and provide a robust analysis of its uncertainty considering the impacts of internal variability, the memory of the system and observational uncertainty.

doi:10.1029/2026gl124264.zh: 通过高分辨率模拟分解南大洋翻转环流，区分次中尺度过程的直接输运与能量逆级联增强中尺度输运的间接作用，强调其参数化价值。
doi:10.1029/2026gl124264.en: Abstract The Southern Ocean meridional overturning circulation (MOC) play a crucial role in the global ocean water mass and heat redistribution, greatly modulating the earth climate variation. Although mesoscale eddies are known as an important component of the residual‐mean MOC that typically oppose wind‐driven Eulerian overturning, the contribution of submesoscale processes remains poorly understood.

doi:10.1029/2026gl125529.zh: 利用理想化沃克环流模拟解释增暖后的双层环流结构，将深对流与层状云模式的周期交替联系起来，揭示对流波动对翻转环流形态的影响。
doi:10.1029/2026gl125529.en: Abstract Idealized mock Walker simulations are widely used to study the interactions between overturning circulation and convection in the tropics. Previous studies documented a transition from a single‐cell to a double‐cell mock Walker circulation when the average sea surface temperature exceeds 300 K.

doi:10.3847/1538-4357/ae93a3.zh: 比较磁场加速吸积与内区热吸积流冷却坍缩两种机制，解释活动星系核快速变脸的时间尺度，检验修正模型与观测转变时间的一致性。
doi:10.3847/1538-4357/ae93a3.en: Abstract SDSS J0225+0030 and SDSS J1723+5504 are two turn-on changing-look active galactic nuclei (CL AGNs) with transition timescales shorter than 1 yr. Such short timescales pose a challenge for the current physical models of CL AGNs.

doi:10.3847/1538-4357/ae9cb9.zh: 在超声速湍流中比较尘气双流体与单流体扩散近似，分析低密度区和尘气比的数值差异，指出方法选择需考虑数值斯托克斯数以避免伪影。
doi:10.3847/1538-4357/ae9cb9.en: Abstract We model 3 and 10 μ m dust grains in supersonic, turbulent molecular cloud conditions to compare two different numerical methods solving dust coupled to gas through a drag term. One method models dust and gas as two separate species (two fluid) and the other the combination of dust and gas as a single mixture (one fluid) using the diffusion approximation.

doi:10.3847/1538-4357/ae93a2.zh: 利用 ALMA 高分辨率观测研究三合星 HD 104237 的紧致环双星盘，分析动力截断下尘气储库的存续及其对行星形成的意义。
doi:10.3847/1538-4357/ae93a2.en: Abstract Planets are rare in close ( a < 10 au) binaries, consistent with millimeter surveys showing that circumbinary disks in such systems are typically fainter than disks around wide binaries or single stars. However, a few bright circumbinary disks deviate from this trend, suggesting that planet-forming reservoirs can sometimes survive severe dynamical truncation.

doi:10.3847/1538-4357/ae9949.zh: 提出恒星本征光谱的后验采样方法，将经验观测与物理模型先验结合，传播光谱不确定性，为径向速度和行星大气表征提供更可靠的输入。
doi:10.3847/1538-4357/ae9949.en: Abstract We present a novel approach to perform posterior sampling of the underlying stellar spectrum in high-resolution spectroscopic observations. Our method, postellar , coherently combines information from empirical observations and physics-based models, enabling more accurate spectral recovery while providing uncertainties that can be propagated into downstream analyses.

doi:10.3847/1538-4357/ae9945.zh: 利用百年太阳 Ca II K 谱斑资料，通过经验模态分解与小波分析识别从日到长期的周期，研究色球结构与太阳磁活动的多尺度联系。
doi:10.3847/1538-4357/ae9945.en: Abstract The solar chromosphere is a key interface layer for understanding magnetic energy transport and multiscale magnetic structures, yet its multi-scale periodic variations from days to a century remain poorly understood. The longest available composite time series of Ca II K plage areas from 1907 February 1 to 2023 December 31 is used to investigate these characteristics by applying the methods of ensemble empirical mode decomposition (EEMD) and continuous wavelet transform.

doi:10.3847/1538-4357/ae9d58.zh: 通过含辐射输运的广义相对论磁流体模拟，比较近爱丁顿吸积中磁场拓扑和黑洞自旋的作用，分析盘结构、磁通积累及不同喷流状态。
doi:10.3847/1538-4357/ae9d58.en: Abstract We present a comprehensive analysis of four near-Eddington black hole accretion models from GRMHD simulations with full radiation transport. This study investigates the dynamical effects of magnetic field topology and black hole spin using two representative choices of each.

doi:10.3847/1538-4357/ae953e.zh: 利用三维辐射流体模拟研究潮汐瓦解事件的吸积盘形成，分析碎片流碰撞、激波和非对称光球如何影响光学与 X 射线辐射及视角依赖。
doi:10.3847/1538-4357/ae953e.en: Abstract The early time emission in tidal disruption events (TDEs) originates from both accretion and shocks, producing photons that eventually emerge from an inhomogeneous photosphere. We model disk formation following debris stream self-intersection in a TDE using three-dimensional, frequency-integrated, and multigroup radiation hydrodynamics simulations.

doi:10.3847/1538-4357/ae9d62.zh: 通过三维磁流体模拟比较具有和缺乏内禀磁场的行星对恒星日冕物质抛射的响应，探索磁层极性变化能否用于诊断系外行星磁场。
doi:10.3847/1538-4357/ae9d62.en: Abstract (Exo)planetary environments are forced by stellar activity, which manifest through variable radiation, particle and magnetic fluxes, stellar winds, flares, and magnetic storms known as coronal mass ejections (CMEs). Recent studies have shown that planets with intrinsic magnetic fields respond differently to stellar wind associated interplanetary magnetic fields (IMFs) compared to planets that lack intrinsic magnetism, as observed in solar system planets.

doi:10.3847/1538-4357/ae9871.zh: 结合多历元径向速度与元素丰度检验富氮场星的起源，评估双星质量转移的贡献，并与球状星团逃逸恒星的解释比较。
doi:10.3847/1538-4357/ae9871.en: Abstract Recent JWST observations have revealed galaxies with unusually high N/O ratios, suggesting that nitrogen enrichment may be common in intense star-forming environments in the early Universe. In the Milky Way, nitrogen-rich (N-rich) stars in the Galactic field have long served as probes of early Galaxy formation and globular cluster (GC) enrichment.

doi:10.3847/1538-4357/ae93a0.zh: 利用 TESS 盾牌座 δ 型星的脉动计时寻找伴星，通过光行时变化拟合轨道并结合天体测量约束，报告褐矮星及一颗可能位于宜居带的行星候选。
doi:10.3847/1538-4357/ae93a0.en: Abstract Substellar companions are most often studied around solar-like or smaller stars, as the rapid rotation and variability of massive stars impede detection using traditional methods. An alternative technique, pulsation timing, uses photometry to measure light-travel-time variations—the time integral of the radial velocity signal—providing orbital constraints with strong sensitivity to intermediate-period companions.

doi:10.3847/1538-4357/ae9f53.zh: 使用多流体磁流体模型研究外日球层太阳风，纳入电荷交换、拾起离子和湍流输运，并与多艘探测器观测比较加热与边界变化的作用。
doi:10.3847/1538-4357/ae9f53.en: Abstract The outer heliosphere is a dynamic region characterized by the perpetual interaction between the solar wind (SW) and the local interstellar medium (LISM). We model the three-dimensional (3D), time-dependent SW flow throughout the outer heliosphere using the Multi-Scale Fluid-Kinetic Simulation Suite (MS-FLUKSS), which, in addition to the thermal SW plasma, accounts for charge exchange between the SW ions and interstellar neutral atoms and treats nonthermal ions (i.e., pickup ions, or PUIs) born during this process as a separate fluid.

doi:10.3847/1538-4357/ae9a76.zh: 估计类地系外行星的潮汐加热与恒星辐照，讨论两者何时可能共同触发失控温室，并通过个例分析轨道、耗散参数和大气组成的影响。
doi:10.3847/1538-4357/ae9a76.en: Abstract The demographics of terrestrial planets and their orbits reveal a vast diversity in overall planetary energy budgets. Terrestrial exoplanets in short-period or eccentric orbits can experience intense tidal heating that, combined with stellar irradiation, may trigger runaway greenhouse conditions analogous to Venus.

doi:10.3847/1538-4357/ae5bb8.zh: 利用流体与辐射传输模拟生成多行星盘图像，训练卷积网络从尘埃环隙推断隐藏行星质量，并在 ALMA 观测中检验预测可靠性。
doi:10.3847/1538-4357/ae5bb8.en: Abstract Identifying young planets and inferring their masses from annular gaps and other substructures observed in protoplanetary disks requires fitting the observed features with hydrodynamical or empirical disk models. The models’ computational cost makes such detections often imprecise or outright impractical.

doi:10.3847/1538-4357/ae9bad.zh: 通过 ALMA 分子谱线拟合扣除开普勒剪切与热展宽，测量 HL Tau 外盘非热速度弥散，分析年轻盘湍流的径向变化及各向异性。
doi:10.3847/1538-4357/ae9bad.en: Abstract Turbulence in protoplanetary disks plays a crucial role in the evolution of disk structures and the planet formation process. However, the strength of the turbulence remains unclear in young, embedded disks surrounded by infalling envelopes.

doi:10.3847/1538-4357/ae9ba6.zh: 利用帕克太阳探测器研究近太阳湍流的动力学尺度统计，比较平行与垂直磁场涨落，并将非高斯性和标度差异与相干结构能量占比联系起来。
doi:10.3847/1538-4357/ae9ba6.en: Abstract We investigate the scale-dependent kurtosis and multifractal properties of magnetic-field increments parallel and perpendicular to the local mean magnetic field using high-cadence Parker Solar Probe measurements of the near-Sun slow solar wind. The results reveal a pronounced anisotropy in kinetic-range statistics: perpendicular fluctuations maintain a nearly constant level of non-Gaussianity across kinetic scales and follow a single scaling law, whereas parallel fluctuations become progressively closer to Gaussian statistics and show scale-dependent scaling behavior.

doi:10.3847/1538-4357/aea076.zh: 构建附近宜居带可直接成像恒星的全波段光谱能量分布，约束高能辐射环境，为行星光化学、加热、大气逃逸及观测目标选择提供输入。
doi:10.3847/1538-4357/aea076.en: Abstract Characterizing the high-energy radiation environments of stars plays a critical role in determining which systems’ planets are capable of retaining atmospheres and sustaining habitable conditions. X-ray through UV radiation drives atmospheric photochemistry, heating, and escape, making accurate characterization of stellar high-energy emission essential for both interpreting future exoplanet observations and identifying the most promising targets for life detection.

doi:10.3847/1538-4357/ae96b2.zh: 利用 DESI 星系—类星体样本中的镁吸收线研究大质量星系周围冷气体，分析覆盖率、运动学及红移演化，讨论卫星供气等可能来源。
doi:10.3847/1538-4357/ae96b2.en: Abstract We investigate the properties of the cool circumgalactic medium (CGM) of massive galaxies and their cosmic evolution. By using the year 1 data set of luminous red galaxies (LRGs) and QSOs from the Dark Energy Spectroscopic Instrument survey, we construct a sample of approximately 800,000 galaxy−quasar pairs and measure the radial distribution and kinematics of the cool gas traced by Mg II absorption lines as a function of galaxy properties from redshift 0.4 to redshift 1.2.

doi:10.3847/1538-4357/ae974e.zh: 结合 MAVEN 离子观测与色散关系推导研究火星磁重力波，解释扰动如何跨越中性大气重力波通常受耗散限制的高度，联系大气与电离层耦合。
doi:10.3847/1538-4357/ae974e.en: Abstract Gravity waves (GWs) are essential to Martian atmospheric dynamics but are typically confined below ∼300 km due to viscous dissipation. Using MAVEN/NGIMS observations (2014–2022), we report persistent ion perturbations extending far beyond this conventional boundary, exhibiting spectral signatures with striking similarity to lower-atmospheric neutral GWs.

doi:10.3847/1538-4357/aea0c9.zh: 将凌日褐矮星的质量和半径与多套演化模型比较，识别半径相关的系统偏差及内禀离散，讨论对次恒星结构和行星质量推断的影响。
doi:10.3847/1538-4357/aea0c9.en: Abstract Transiting brown dwarfs provide a direct empirical test of substellar evolutionary models, and with more than 50 now known, we can carry out this test at the population level. We compared the observed masses and radii of 31 field-age, weakly irradiated transiting brown dwarfs to the Sonora Diamondback, Sonora Bobcat, and ATMO 2020 grids, and a subset of 23 of them to the irradiated models of S.

doi:10.3847/1538-4357/ae9eb1.zh: 利用太阳磁图比较孤立黑子衰减速率与周围磁场湍流谱，检验外部湍流状态能否解释磁通损失，并讨论黑子内部过程的可能作用。
