doi:10.3847/1538-4357/ae9eb1.en: Abstract Using magnetograms acquired with the Helioseismic and Magnetic Imager (HMI) on board the Solar Dynamics Observatory (SDO), we explored the rate of magnetic flux decay in the umbra of a single sunspot and the characteristics of magnetic field turbulence in the surrounding magnetic environment (SME) of the sunspot. The unsigned magnetic flux was calculated over the region covered by the ∣ B r ∣ = 600 Mx cm −2 isolevel.

doi:10.3847/1538-4357/ae99c7.zh: 通过贯通对流层上部至日冕的三维辐射磁流体模拟，自洽研究阿尔芬波产生与耗散，比较不同加热机制对日冕能量供应的作用。
doi:10.3847/1538-4357/ae99c7.en: Abstract Alfvénic waves are prevalent throughout the solar atmosphere and are believed to play an essential role in coronal heating, classified as alternating current (AC) heating in contrast to direct current (DC) heating associated with quasi-static magnetic field line braiding. The relative importance of AC versus DC heating depends on the details of the photospheric driver and on the configuration of the magnetic field.

doi:10.3847/1538-4357/ae986b.zh: 耦合三维流体、非平衡热化学与辐射传输研究 WASP-121b 外层大气，分析昼夜环流、光蒸发外流和螺旋臂，以及不同谱线所探测的区域。
doi:10.3847/1538-4357/ae986b.en: Abstract We present three-dimensional simulations of the ultrahot Jupiter (UHJ) WASP-121b from the planetary surface to extended outflows, coupling hydrodynamics with consistent nonequilibrium thermochemistry, ray-tracing radiative transfer, and hydrodynamics using the GPU-accelerated Kratos framework. The fiducial model exhibits several atmospheric layers, including the lower atmospheres controlled by day–night circulation, and transonic photoevaporative outflows at higher altitudes shaped into two spiral arms by the stellar gravity and orbital motion effects.

doi:10.3847/1538-4357/ae9d7b.zh: 利用相对论等离子体粒子模拟追踪磁镜加速，分析湍流压缩磁场如何改变粒子能量和俯仰角，并通过空间约束进一步影响加速效率。
doi:10.3847/1538-4357/ae9d7b.en: Abstract Efficient relativistic turbulent acceleration of particles is indicated by recent astrophysical observations. The acceleration mechanism due to temporal variations of magnetic field strengths (“Type II mechanism”) remains underexplored.

doi:10.3847/1538-4357/aea15b.zh: 提出用于系外行星大气化学动力学的神经网络替代求解器，以残差流映射预测化学状态演变，探索在多维大气模拟中加速非平衡化学计算。
doi:10.3847/1538-4357/aea15b.en: Abstract Observations increasingly reveal the coupled radiative, chemical, and dynamical processes that shape exoplanet atmospheres. Interpreting these atmospheres requires models that can capture this complexity.

doi:10.3847/2041-8213/ae8c2d.zh: 统一分析多颗行星的 JWST/MIRI 透射光谱，比较分子吸收、随机噪声和仪器系统误差等解释，强调具体分子识别及生物或非生物来源仍需更多观测。
doi:10.3847/2041-8213/ae8c2d.en: Abstract The launch of JWST has enabled unprecedented atmospheric characterization of exoplanets. In particular, the JWST-MIRI instrument in the mid-infrared enables probing of molecular species that are harder to detect in the near-infrared.

doi:10.3847/2041-8213/aea0ca.zh: 以随机力矩描述湍流吸积盘对极端质量比旋近轨道的影响，估计其引起的引力波相位偏移，并讨论长期流体模拟对约束该效应的必要性。
doi:10.3847/2041-8213/aea0ca.en: Abstract Gravitational wave (GW) detector LISA will observe near-coalescence extreme mass ratio inspirals (EMRIs), which typically form in galactic central accretion disks. Torques from the disk can alter the GW-driven inspiral trajectory of an embedded EMRI from the vacuum expectation, leading to potentially observable GW dephasing (Δ ψ gas ).

doi:10.3847/2041-8213/ae9bb6.zh: 利用 Keck 高对比度成像搜索有环隙盘中的原行星，报告 Elias 2-24 伴星候选的确认结果，并讨论其对年轻盘环隙及行星形成时间尺度的约束。
doi:10.3847/2041-8213/ae9bb6.en: Abstract We present high-contrast imaging observations of seven stars obtained with the Keck/NIRC2 vortex coronagraph between 2018 May and June in the L ′ and M s bands. All targets host protoplanetary disks with substructures such as gaps and cavities, potentially tracing ongoing planet formation.

doi:10.3847/2041-8213/aea15e.zh: 联合径向速度与 Hipparcos–Gaia 天体测量研究凌日内行星和外侧巨行星的轨道结构，通过层级贝叶斯推断检验总体共面程度。
doi:10.3847/2041-8213/aea15e.en: Abstract The mutual inclination between inner planets and distant giant companions provides an important probe of planetary system formation and dynamical evolution, yet direct measurements of this quantity remain scarce. We combine radial velocity (RV) observations with Hipparcos–Gaia astrometry to constrain the orbital architecture of 19 planetary systems hosting at least one transiting inner planet and one outer giant companion.

doi:10.3847/2041-8213/ae9a72.zh: 通过轨道数值演化研究银心年轻高速星的产生，检验偏心恒星盘与黑洞引力弹弓如何提高抛射率，并预测与老年高速星不同的空间分布。
doi:10.3847/2041-8213/ae9a72.en: Abstract About twenty late B-type hypervelocity stars (HVSs) traveling faster than the Galactic escape velocity have been discovered in the Galactic halo, many of which were ejected from the Galactic center (GC). Recently, we have advocated that these HVSs most likely formed in the nuclear star cluster (NSC) 150–500 Myr ago and were predominantly ejected via the gravitational slingshot of a past intermediate-mass black hole (IMBH) orbiting the supermassive black hole (SMBH) Sgr A * .

doi:10.3847/2041-8213/aea3f5.zh: 在 JWST/MIRI 短曝光标定图像中发现恒星伴星，评估点扩散函数匹配对近距离伴星探测的能力，讨论短时非日冕成像搜索冷巨行星的潜力。
doi:10.3847/2041-8213/aea3f5.en: Abstract We report the direct imaging detection of a stellar companion to HD 101452 (HIP 56925; Gaia DR3 5384905720847544192), an A star historically used as an infrared flux calibrator. The companion was identified from an asymmetry in the stellar point-spread function (PSF) using short-integration (<1 minute), noncoronagraphic JWST MIRI imaging from 15 to 25.5 μ m that was obtained as part of the absolute flux calibration program CAL 4496.

doi:10.3847/2041-8213/aea4ae.zh: 利用 JWST 透射光谱及更新的辐射—对流—光化学模型研究 TOI-6894 b，分析甲烷、氨和含硫分子特征对大气金属丰度与化学过程的约束。
doi:10.3847/2041-8213/aea4ae.en: Abstract We report the JWST NIRSpec/PRISM transit spectrum of TOI-6894 b, an exceptional 420 K sub-Saturn that is one of the rare giant planets transiting a late M dwarf. Remarkably, both the light curve and the transit spectrum exhibit almost no stellar contamination.

doi:10.3847/2041-8213/aea4af.zh: 以 TOI-6894 b 为例模拟温凉巨行星的硫化学，分析甲烷和硫化氢储库、热化学及光解共同生成二硫化碳的路径，探索其对金属丰度的诊断作用。
doi:10.3847/2041-8213/aea4af.en: Abstract Sulfur chemistry has emerged as an important probe of exoplanet atmospheres in the JWST era, although observational constraints have thus far been largely limited to SO 2 and H 2 S in warm and hot exoplanets. Recent JWST observations have revealed CS 2 in several cooler gas giant exoplanets, yielding a new tracer of sulfur chemistry.

doi:10.3847/2041-8213/aea3eb.zh: 交叉匹配年轻星团与 Gaia 非单星目录，结合伴星质量和天体测量质量比筛选致密天体候选，为后续光谱和成像确认安排优先目标。
doi:10.3847/2041-8213/aea3eb.en: Abstract The search for massive compact objects such as black holes (BHs) or neutron stars (NSs) in star clusters is a longstanding challenge in astrophysics, yet no definitive identification of such compact objects in young clusters has been reported. In this Letter, we construct a sample of high-priority candidates for follow-up investigation.

doi:10.1175/jas-d-26-0053.1.zh: 利用云室直接数值模拟检验大涡模拟中的过饱和度亚网格模型，分析湍流温湿涨落与凝结反馈如何影响液滴活化、增长及滴谱。
doi:10.1175/jas-d-26-0053.1.en: Abstract Turbulent fluctuations of supersaturation, driven by water vapor and temperature variability, significantly influence cloud droplet activation and drop size distributions (DSDs). Accurate modeling of this variability is challenging because of the complex interactions among turbulent mixing and the phase change itself, affecting the variabilities and covariabilities of scalar fields.

doi:10.1175/jas-d-26-0015.1.zh: 构建跟随气旋移动的局地能量框架，分析台风海贝思向温带气旋转变期间非绝热加热、背景流转换和非对称结构的能量联系。
doi:10.1175/jas-d-26-0015.1.en: Abstract Tropical cyclones (TCs) moving into the midlatitudes often undergo notable structural changes as they transition into extratropical cyclones (ETCs). This transition, known as the extratropical transition (ET), results from interactions between the TC and the midlatitude baroclinic environment.

doi:10.1175/jas-d-26-0029.1.zh: 比较多类模拟云场中的一维与三维短波辐射，分离直接光截获与散射透射贡献，指出云几何与太阳天顶角是地表辐射差异的重要控制因素。
doi:10.1175/jas-d-26-0029.1.en: Most atmospheric models treat radiative transfer as a one-dimensional (1D) process, producing differences in surface flux termed three-dimensional (3D) radiative effects. Modeled shortwave 3D radiative effects on domain-averaged surface flux are positive with the sun overhead (i.e., 1D surface flux is artificially dim) and negative when the sun is near the horizon.

doi:10.1175/jas-d-25-0184.1.zh: 利用再分析研究对流层上部和平流层下部的三维剩余环流，分离定常波、瞬变波和非地转扰动贡献，连接布鲁尔—多布森浅支与对流层输送。
doi:10.1175/jas-d-25-0184.1.en: Abstract Three-dimensional (3D) structure of the residual circulation in the upper troposphere and lower stratosphere during solstice seasons was investigated using a 3D residual flow applicable to both stationary and transient waves. This circulation corresponds to the shallow branch of the Brewer–Dobson circulation in the lower stratosphere and seamlessly connects with the tropospheric circulation.

doi:10.1175/jas-d-25-0102.1.zh: 利用森林采伐空地的分布式温度和湍流观测检验泰勒冻结湍流假设，发现非均匀强湍流中时空相关更适合用考虑随机扫掠的椭圆模型描述。
doi:10.1175/jas-d-25-0102.1.en: Taylor’s hypothesis (TH) converts temporal observations to spatial information of the flow while carrying out measurements on a micrometeorological tower. Other than TH, there exists a more general elliptic model, which converts time to space by focusing on the geometry of the space–time correlation function.

doi:10.5194/acp-13-1093-2013.zh: 提出利用水分守恒与再分析对流降水诊断深对流输送的离线方案，包含卷入和卷出，并以氡示踪剂观测检验化学输送模型的垂直混合作用。
doi:10.5194/acp-13-1093-2013.en: A modified cumulus convection parametrisation scheme is presented. This scheme computes the mass of air transported upward in a cumulus cell using conservation of moisture and a detailed distribution of convective precipitation provided by a reanalysis dataset.

doi:10.5194/acp-13-3245-2013.zh: 在多模式中规定相同气溶胶光学性质，分离宿主模式自身带来的辐射强迫不确定性，强调云、地表反照率和辐射计算差异不能忽略。
doi:10.5194/acp-13-3245-2013.en: Simulated multi-model "diversity" in aerosol direct radiative forcing estimates is often perceived as a measure of aerosol uncertainty. However, current models used for aerosol radiative forcing calculations vary considerably in model components relevant for forcing calculations and the associated "host-model uncertainties" are generally convoluted with the actual aerosol uncertainty.

doi:10.5194/acp-14-3657-2014.zh: 结合多源观测与全球气溶胶模式研究数十年变化，比较人为排放、自然沙尘和火山影响，说明全球平均值可能掩盖明显的区域差异。
doi:10.5194/acp-14-3657-2014.en: Aerosol variations and trends over different land and ocean regions from 1980 to 2009 are analyzed with the Goddard Chemistry Aerosol Radiation and Transport (GOCART) model and observations from multiple satellite sensors and available ground-based networks. Excluding time periods with large volcanic influence, aerosol optical depth (AOD) and surface concentration over polluted land regions generally vary with anthropogenic emissions, but the magnitude of this association can be dampened by the presence of natural aerosols, especially dust.

doi:10.5194/acp-14-10845-2014.zh: 通过 AeroCom 多模式比较评估全球有机气溶胶模拟，分析排放、二次生成、老化和多相过程的差异，指出更复杂的方案并不自动消除观测偏差。
doi:10.5194/acp-14-10845-2014.en: This paper evaluates the current status of global modeling of the organic aerosol (OA) in the troposphere and analyzes the differences between models as well as between models and observations. Thirty-one global chemistry transport models (CTMs) and general circulation models (GCMs) have participated in this intercomparison, in the framework of AeroCom phase II.

doi:10.5194/acp-14-12465-2014.zh: 利用多次飞机观测约束黑碳垂直分布和寿命，检验多模式对远洋长距离输送及辐射强迫的估计，强调湿清除等寿命控制过程的重要性。
doi:10.5194/acp-14-12465-2014.en: Atmospheric black carbon (BC) absorbs solar radiation, and exacerbates global warming through exerting positive radiative forcing (RF). However, the contribution of BC to ongoing changes in global climate is under debate.

doi:10.5194/acp-16-14805-2016.zh: 使用 CAM5 分析开放火源气溶胶的季节和空间辐射效应，区分直接吸收散射、云响应及雪面反照率变化对整体能量收支的贡献。
doi:10.5194/acp-16-14805-2016.en: Aerosols from open-land fires could significantly perturb the global radiation balance and induce climate change. In this study, Community Atmosphere Model version 5 (CAM5) with prescribed daily fire aerosol emissions is used to investigate the spatial and seasonal characteristics of radiative effects (REs, relative to the case of no fires) of open-fire aerosols including black carbon (BC) and particulate organic matter (POM) from 2003 to 2011.

doi:10.5194/acp-17-4731-2017.zh: 将 CAM5 模拟沿 HIPPO 飞行轨迹与冰云实测比较，检验云发生率和微物理性质，分析亚网格湿度、冰核化及冰晶增长方案造成的偏差。
doi:10.5194/acp-17-4731-2017.en: In this study we evaluate cloud properties simulated by the Community Atmosphere Model version 5 (CAM5) using in situ measurements from the HIAPER Pole-to-Pole Observations (HIPPO) campaign for the period of 2009 to 2011. The modeled wind and temperature are nudged towards reanalysis.

doi:10.5194/acp-17-12197-2017.zh: 比较多模式和两极气溶胶观测，分析不同组分的季节变化及长距离输送，量化寿命和输送假设对极地光学厚度与辐射影响的不确定性。
doi:10.5194/acp-17-12197-2017.en: Atmospheric aerosols from anthropogenic and natural sources reach the polar regions through long-range transport and affect the local radiation balance. Such transport is, however, poorly constrained in present-day global climate models, and few multi-model evaluations of polar anthropogenic aerosol radiative forcing exist.

doi:10.5194/acp-18-31-2018.zh: 利用约束式后报集合评估北美火源气溶胶短期有效辐射强迫，区分排放清单、注入高度及大气混沌响应的不确定性，强调集合估计的必要性。
doi:10.5194/acp-18-31-2018.en: Aerosols from fire emissions can potentially have large impact on clouds and radiation. However, fire aerosol sources are often intermittent, and their effect on weather and climate is difficult to quantify.

doi:10.5194/acp-18-1065-2018.zh: 利用长期卫星观测研究气溶胶与冰晶有效半径的关系，揭示湿润和干燥环境下相关性可相反，强调水汽条件对冰云辐射效应估算的调制。
doi:10.5194/acp-18-1065-2018.en: The interactions between aerosols and ice clouds represent one of the largest uncertainties in global radiative forcing from pre-industrial time to the present. In particular, the impact of aerosols on ice crystal effective radius ( R ei ), which is a key parameter determining ice clouds' net radiative effect, is highly uncertain due to limited and conflicting observational evidence.

doi:10.5194/acp-18-1395-2018.zh: 比较不同排放清单驱动的全球气候模拟与观测，诊断中国东部气溶胶偏差，区分排放输入和前体气体向二次粒子转化过程的作用。
doi:10.5194/acp-18-1395-2018.en: Global climate models often underestimate aerosol loadings in China, and these biases can have significant implications for anthropogenic aerosol radiative forcing and climate effects. The biases may be caused by either the emission inventory or the treatment of aerosol processes in the models, or both, but so far no consensus has been reached.

doi:10.5194/acp-18-4519-2018.zh: 通过实验检验流星烟尘和碎片类似物触发硝酸水合物成核的能力，并结合全球分布估计，解释无水冰条件下早季极地平流层云的形成。
doi:10.5194/acp-18-4519-2018.en: Heterogeneous nucleation of crystalline nitric acid hydrates in polar stratospheric clouds (PSCs) enhances ozone depletion. However, the identity and mode of action of the particles responsible for nucleation remains unknown.

doi:10.5194/acp-18-15783-2018.zh: 比较显式处理气溶胶混合态的新方案与默认 CAM5，分析寿命、云性质及辐射差异，评估微物理表述对人为气溶胶有效辐射强迫的影响。
doi:10.5194/acp-18-15783-2018.en: We quantify the effective radiative forcing (ERF) of anthropogenic aerosols modelled by the aerosol–climate model CAM5.3-MARC-ARG. CAM5.3-MARC-ARG is a new configuration of the Community Atmosphere Model version 5.3 (CAM5.3) in which the default aerosol module has been replaced by the two-Moment, Multi-Modal, Mixing-state-resolving Aerosol model for Research of Climate (MARC).

doi:10.5194/acp-19-8591-2019.zh: 将全球多模式的粒子数、云凝结核和推算云滴数与地面观测比较，评估均值与时间变率，指出匹配平均云滴数不等于正确模拟其敏感度。
doi:10.5194/acp-19-8591-2019.en: A total of 16 global chemistry transport models and general circulation models have participated in this study; 14 models have been evaluated with regard to their ability to reproduce the near-surface observed number concentration of aerosol particles and cloud condensation nuclei (CCN), as well as derived cloud droplet number concentration (CDNC). Model results for the period 2011–2015 are compared with aerosol measurements (aerosol particle number, CCN and aerosol particle composition in the submicron fraction) from nine surface stations located in Europe and Japan.

doi:10.5194/acp-19-12025-2019.zh: 通过变分辨率 CESM 试验分离黑碳和沙尘的大气辐射与积雪变暗效应，分析高原热力、急流及环流调整对南亚季风水循环的影响。
doi:10.5194/acp-19-12025-2019.en: Black carbon (BC) and dust impart significant effects on the South Asian monsoon (SAM), which is responsible for ∼80 % of the region's annual precipitation. This study implements a variable-resolution (VR) version of the Community Earth System Model (CESM) to quantify two radiative effects of absorbing BC and dust on the SAM.

doi:10.5194/acp-20-10911-2020.zh: 利用允许对流的 WRF-Chem 比较落基山积雪变暗与大气辐射作用，揭示吸光粒子可通过相反的地表能量变化改变融雪和径流季节分配。
doi:10.5194/acp-20-10911-2020.en: The Weather Research and Forecasting model coupled with Chemistry (WRF-Chem) is run to quantify the in-snow and atmospheric radiative effects of black carbon (BC) and dust on a convective-allowing (4 km) grid for water year 2009 across a large area of the Rocky Mountains. The snow-darkening effect (SDE) due to the deposition of these light-absorbing particles (LAPs) on surface snow enhances snowmelt by 3 to 12 mm during late spring and early summer, effectuating surface runoff increases (decreases) prior to (after) June.

doi:10.5194/acp-21-2305-2021.zh: 将海洋有机气溶胶加入 CAM6，比较其作为云凝结核和浸没冻结冰核的作用，评估对高纬混合相云及地表能量收支的影响。
doi:10.5194/acp-21-2305-2021.en: Mixed-phase clouds are frequently observed in high-latitude regions and have important impacts on the surface energy budget and regional climate. Marine organic aerosol (MOA), a natural source of aerosol emitted over ∼ 70 % of Earth's surface, may significantly modify the properties and radiative forcing of mixed-phase clouds.

doi:10.5194/acp-21-12359-2021.zh: 整合卫星、地面观测和输送模拟研究 2020 年非洲强沙尘跨大西洋输运，诊断羽流高度与强度偏差，强调湿对流、冷池及垂直输送表述的重要性。
doi:10.5194/acp-21-12359-2021.en: This study characterizes a massive African dust intrusion into the Caribbean Basin and southern US in June 2020, which is nicknamed the “Godzilla” dust plume, using a comprehensive set of satellite and ground-based observations (including MODIS, CALIOP, SEVIRI, AERONET, and EPA Air Quality network) and the NASA GEOS global aerosol transport model. The MODIS data record registered this massive dust intrusion event as the most intense episode over the past 2 decades.

doi:10.5194/acp-21-17727-2021.zh: 用不同气溶胶混合态指标评估模态方案的结构不确定性，比较吸光性、碳质组分和吸湿性的混合表述，为改进辐射及云相互作用提供诊断。
doi:10.5194/acp-21-17727-2021.en: Aerosol mixing state is an important emergent property that affects aerosol radiative forcing and aerosol–cloud interactions, but it has not been easy to constrain this property globally. This study aims to verify the global distribution of aerosol mixing state represented by modal models.

doi:10.5194/acp-22-1549-2022.zh: 扩展海洋二甲基硫氧化反应路径，研究中间产物如何改变洁净及工业化前气溶胶背景，进而影响人为气溶胶间接辐射强迫的估计。
doi:10.5194/acp-22-1549-2022.en: Aerosol indirect radiative forcing (IRF), which characterizes how aerosols alter cloud formation and properties, is very sensitive to the preindustrial (PI) aerosol burden. Dimethyl sulfide (DMS), emitted from the ocean, is a dominant natural precursor of non-sea-salt sulfate in the PI and pristine present-day (PD) atmospheres.

doi:10.5194/acp-22-2585-2022.zh: 在单柱模式中联合检验初生冰核化和多种次生冰过程，发现二者可通过混合相云冰化与降水粒子供给相互抑制，影响冰晶数量解释。
doi:10.5194/acp-22-2585-2022.en: A discrepancy of up to 5 orders of magnitude between ice crystal and ice nucleating particle (INP) number concentrations was found in the measurements, indicating the potentially important role of secondary ice production (SIP) in the clouds. However, the interactions between primary and SIP processes and their relative importance remain unexplored.

doi:10.5194/acp-22-5223-2022.zh: 将基于界面分配的 OCEANFILMS 海盐有机气溶胶方案加入地球系统模式，连接海洋生物地球化学、海喷雾组成与云效应，检验观测一致性。
doi:10.5194/acp-22-5223-2022.en: Sea spray aerosol is one of the major sources of atmospheric particulate matter globally. It has increasingly been recognized that organic matter derived from ocean biological precursors contributes significantly to the composition of submicron sea spray and may modify sea spray aerosol impacts on clouds and climate.

doi:10.5194/acp-22-9129-2022.zh: 利用长期与约束式模拟分解 E3SM 人为气溶胶有效辐射强迫，分析历史区域差异及参数敏感性，讨论液态和混合相云对净强迫的控制。
doi:10.5194/acp-22-9129-2022.en: The effective radiative forcing of anthropogenic aerosols (ERF aer ) is an important measure of the anthropogenic aerosol effects simulated by a global climate model. Here we analyze ERF aer simulated by the E3SM version 1 (E3SMv1) atmospheric model using both century-long free-running atmosphere–land simulations and short nudged simulations.

doi:10.5194/acp-22-11009-2022.zh: 以多套卫星产品评估 AeroCom 对主要生物质燃烧区气溶胶的模拟，比较排放、清除和光学性质偏差，检验不同火源环境下的共同问题。
doi:10.5194/acp-22-11009-2022.en: Global models are widely used to simulate biomass burning aerosol (BBA). Exhaustive evaluations on model representation of aerosol distributions and properties are fundamental to assess health and climate impacts of BBA.

doi:10.5194/acp-23-2199-2023.zh: 将极化无线电掩星差分相位与 CloudSat 冰水含量比较，考虑临边观测几何，建立对水平取向冰粒子及其垂直分布的全球观测约束。
doi:10.5194/acp-23-2199-2023.en: The Radio Occultations and Heavy Precipitation (ROHP) experiment aboard the Spanish PAZ satellite was deployed in 2018 with the objective of demonstrating the ability of the polarimetric radio occultation measurement (PRO) concept in detecting rain (liquid-phase precipitation). Analysis of these data has also demonstrated the ability of PRO to detect horizontally oriented frozen-phase precipitation.

doi:10.5194/acp-24-1717-2024.zh: 利用 ATom 飞机观测评估多模式海洋硫循环，比较二甲基硫、二氧化硫、甲磺酸盐和硫酸盐的垂直与季节分布，诊断化学及输送偏差。
doi:10.5194/acp-24-1717-2024.en: The atmospheric sulfur cycle plays a key role in air quality, climate, and ecosystems, such as pollution, radiative forcing, new particle formation, and acid rain. In this study, we compare the spatially and temporally resolved measurements from the NASA Atmospheric Tomography (ATom) mission with simulations from five AeroCom III models for four sulfur species (dimethyl sulfide (DMS), sulfur dioxide (SO 2 ), particulate methanesulfonate (MSA), and particulate sulfate (SO 4 )).

doi:10.5194/acp-24-7331-2024.zh: 检验云液水路径与云滴数的现今负相关能否约束人为气溶胶响应，指出相关性与强迫试验中的因果调整并不等同，影响云辐射强迫推断。
doi:10.5194/acp-24-7331-2024.en: General circulation models' (GCMs) estimates of the liquid water path adjustment to anthropogenic aerosol emissions differ in sign from other lines of evidence. This reduces confidence in estimates of the effective radiative forcing of the climate by aerosol–cloud interactions (ERFaci).

doi:10.5194/acp-25-4665-2025.zh: 汇编细粒径和粗粒径气溶胶组成观测，结合模式研究空间差异，为评估地区组分、排放趋势及气候辐射影响提供统一资料基础。
doi:10.5194/acp-25-4665-2025.en: Aerosol particles are an important part of the Earth climate system, and their concentrations are spatially and temporally heterogeneous, as well as being variable in size and composition. Particles can interact with incoming solar radiation and outgoing longwave radiation, change cloud properties, affect photochemistry, impact surface air quality, change the albedo of snow and ice, and modulate carbon dioxide uptake by the land and ocean.

doi:10.5194/acp-25-5911-2025.zh: 比较 EMAC 不同垂直分辨率与约束配置的温湿度，评估对流层顶附近水汽梯度对尾迹形成区诊断的影响，分析提高预测准确性的途径。
doi:10.5194/acp-25-5911-2025.en: While carbon dioxide emissions from aviation often dominate climate change discussions, non-CO 2 effects such as contrails and contrail cirrus must also be considered. Despite varying estimates of their radiative forcing, avoiding contrails is a reasonable strategy for reducing aviation’s climate effects.

doi:10.5194/acp-25-7789-2025.zh: 使用全球公里尺度 ICON 模拟气溶胶引起的云与降水快速调整，比较区域差异，并讨论内部变率、微物理方案和观测时长对结论的限制。
doi:10.5194/acp-25-7789-2025.en: Anthropogenic aerosols are a primary source of uncertainty in future climate projections. Changes to aerosol concentrations modify cloud radiative properties, radiative fluxes, and precipitation from the microphysical to the global scale.

doi:10.5194/acp-25-11317-2025.zh: 结合吸附理论与经典成核理论，研究不溶基底上水膜的均相冻结，分析膜厚和基底性质对熔点、临界冰核与成核率的影响。
doi:10.5194/acp-25-11317-2025.en: Ice nucleation plays a critical role in cloud formation and atmospheric processes, influencing precipitation and climate. In this study, we present a theoretical approach for describing homogeneous ice nucleation within adsorbed water films on insoluble substrates and suggest that it may be a mechanism for deposition ice nucleation with non-porous ice nuclei that induce ice premelting.

doi:10.5194/acp-25-15369-2025.zh: 在 CAM6 中比较两套冰核化方案，通过敏感性试验区分地形重力波、对流卷出和湍流对卷云冰晶的贡献，并与飞机观测检验。
doi:10.5194/acp-25-15369-2025.en: Ice crystal formation in cirrus clouds is poorly understood, and its representation remains a challenge in global climate models. To enhance the understanding, a novel ice nucleation parameterization based on the Kärcher (2022) (K22) scheme is introduced into the NCAR Community Atmosphere Model version 6 (CAM6).

doi:10.5194/acp-25-17797-2025.zh: 利用极化无线电掩星的相位差诊断大气河水凝物结构，比较不同微物理假设及冰粒子形状，探索用观测约束降水参数化。
doi:10.5194/acp-25-17797-2025.en: Improving the representation of precipitation in weather and climate models remains a major challenge, particularly due to uncertainties in microphysical parameterizations that govern hydrometeor characteristics and behavior. The Polarimetric Radio Occultation (PRO) technique enhances the standard Radio Occultation (RO) method by offering vertical profiles of both precipitation structure and thermodynamic atmospheric variables.

doi:10.5194/acp-26-10331-2026.zh: 通过系留气球观测研究北极低云上下的气溶胶分层，量化自由对流层粒子对云凝结核及云滴的补给，分析忽略高空粒子层的长波辐射偏差。
doi:10.5194/acp-26-10331-2026.en: Aerosol-cloud-radiation interactions are a major source of uncertainty in the Arctic climate, particularly for low-level clouds (LLC) that dominate cloud cover. This study presents in situ measurements of aerosols and cloud droplets collected with a tethered balloon between 16 May and 10 June 2023, during the Atmospheric Rivers and the onseT of sea ice MELT campaign above sea ice in the Fram Strait.

doi:10.5194/acp-26-10647-2026.zh: 利用粒子分辨模式比较组成平均化与表面张力假设，说明两种误差可能在云凝结核预测中相互抵消，因此均值吻合不一定代表活化物理正确。
doi:10.5194/acp-26-10647-2026.en: Accurate predictions of cloud condensation nuclei (CCN) activation are essential for reducing uncertainties in aerosol-cloud interactions and climate projections. Most large-scale aerosol models represent particles as compositionally averaged internal mixtures and assume constant surface tension of water, neglecting particle-level compositional variability and surfactant-driven reductions in surface tension.

doi:10.1029/2025jd044809.zh: 通过全新世轨道强迫切片试验研究温度极端，分析日照和季风降水对暖、冷事件的不同调制，并比较轨道变化与人为增暖响应。
doi:10.1029/2025jd044809.en: Abstract Using a set of slice experiments driven primarily by orbital forcing, we examine the evolution of extreme temperature events throughout the Holocene, particularly their response to insolation and precipitation changes. Warm extremes exhibit broadly linear trends: they are more intense and frequent in the early‐Holocene and weaken toward the pre‐industrial period.

doi:10.1029/2025jd045070.zh: 构建热带砧云生命周期的解析模型，耦合扩展、微物理和长短波辐射，解释两类强迫近抵消及其对初始温度和对流发生时刻的敏感性。
doi:10.1029/2025jd045070.en: Abstract Satellite observations and numerical simulations show that the small net Cloud Radiative Effect (CRE) of tropical anvil clouds results from a near‐cancellation between large but opposing longwave (LW) and shortwave (SW) components over the cloud's lifecycle. We develop an analytical model that captures this behavior by combining: (1) simple parameterizations of LW and SW CRE as functions of SW cloud optical depth; (2) a two‐phase cloud spreading model, incorporating both initial convective detrainment and subsequent radiatively driven expansion; and (3) a minimal cloud microphysics scheme.

doi:10.1029/2025jd044278.zh: 开发区分吸收与散射的平流层气溶胶辐射核，考虑光谱及温度调整，用于高效估计火山和野火事件引起的大气顶辐射变化。
doi:10.1029/2025jd044278.en: Abstract To facilitate the quantification of the stratospheric aerosol direct radiative effect (ARE), this study develops a suite of aerosol kernels based on Modern‐Era Retrospective Analysis for Research and Applications, Version 2 reanalysis data. The kernels comprise a five‐dimensional data set that includes latitude, longitude, time, wavelength, and radiative forcing scenarios.

doi:10.1029/2025jd044818.zh: 比较同化与未同化大气河侦察投落送的预报，评估观测对水汽输送、环流及美国西岸降水的改进，为定向观测策略提供依据。
doi:10.1029/2025jd044818.en: Abstract Landfalling Atmospheric Rivers (ARs) are crucial for the water resources on the U.S. West Coast, but can also cause hazardous weather and water events there.

doi:10.1029/2025jd044471.zh: 通过湿静能收支比较澳大利亚季风活跃脉冲在当前和暖海温模拟中的演变，强调水平水汽平流及参数化差异对爆发过程和未来响应的影响。
doi:10.1029/2025jd044471.en: Abstract This study investigates the complex dynamics of burst evolution in the Australian summer monsoon under present‐day and warmer climate conditions. Using reanalysis data, historical atmosphere‐only simulations (AMIP), and simulations with uniformly increased sea surface temperatures (+4K; AMIP+4K), we examine how seasonal‐mean precipitation and burst behavior respond to warming across eight climate models.

doi:10.1029/2025jd043335.zh: 比较多套北极大气河识别算法，量化定义差异对热量、水汽输送、下行长波和降水贡献的影响，说明强异常事件与总体气候贡献需分别评估。
doi:10.1029/2025jd043335.en: Abstract Atmospheric rivers (ARs) significantly impact the Arctic climate system by enhancing atmospheric heat and moisture transport and altering the local energy budget. Developing AR detection tools (ARDTs) is critical yet challenging.

doi:10.1029/2025jd044428.zh: 通过分别改变大气、陆地和海洋初始状态的后报试验，分离南美降水次季节可预报性来源，并探索独立于 ENSO 和 MJO 的热带加热联系。
doi:10.1029/2025jd044428.en: Abstract This study investigates the sources of predictability underlying subseasonal precipitation skill over South America in existing subseasonal prediction systems. Using subseasonal re‐forecasts from the NCAR‐CESM2 model, we demonstrate that significant skill persists even when interannual variability is removed.

doi:10.1029/2025jd043780.zh: 在三个观测站开展陆面参数扰动集合试验，识别碳—水循环预测的敏感参数并与通量资料比较，讨论站点约束推广到区域尺度的限制。
doi:10.1029/2025jd043780.en: Abstract A newly developed simulation tool, the National Center for Atmospheric Research–National Ecological Observatory Network (NCAR‐NEON) modeling framework, offers a promising opportunity to investigate parameter sensitivity in climate models. This is primarily due to its ultra‐efficient computational design and the availability of high‐quality NEON observational data.

doi:10.1029/2025jd045461.zh: 结合环流故事线与概率归因研究 2022 年亚洲热浪—洪涝复合事件，分离大气环流、拉尼娜和人为增暖对不同地区并发极端的作用。
doi:10.1029/2025jd045461.en: Abstract An unprecedented spatially compound heatwave‐flooding event (SCHFE) affected the Yangtze River Basin (YRB) and Northwestern South Asia (NWSA) during summer 2022, causing severe socioeconomic impacts. However, attributing such compound extremes remains challenging due to the lack of integrated frameworks that capture both physical causality and probabilistic assessment.

doi:10.1029/2025jd044599.zh: 比较不同海盆热带气旋潜在强度阈值的向极扩展，用热力收支分离增暖与其他因素，揭示西边界流附近及南北半球响应的差异。
doi:10.1029/2025jd044599.en: Abstract Favorable thermodynamic environments for tropical cyclone (TCs), as measured by potential intensity (PI), expand to higher latitudes in a warming climate, in both observations and future simulations. However, this expansion rate has yet to be compared systematically between hemispheres and across basins.

doi:10.1029/2025jd045096.zh: 客观识别全球低层大尺度辐合线并按湿度分类，比较印度、西非和澳大利亚季风中的位置、频率与降水关系，揭示区域动力配置差异。
doi:10.1029/2025jd045096.en: Abstract Low‐level (1,000–850 hPa), 6‐day time‐mean large‐scale convergence lines are identified objectively in the ERA5 reanalysis and are sorted into two classes according to whether the local specific humidity is high (high‐q) or low (low‐q). The high‐q convergence lines lie in the tropics, and in particular in the Intertropical Convergence Zone (ITCZ).

doi:10.1029/2025jd045016.zh: 利用外场观测评估不同单柱对流和湍流方案对混合罗斯贝—重力波的表述，指出相近降水量可对应明显不同的加热、温湿结构和波动响应。
doi:10.1029/2025jd045016.en: Abstract Leveraging observational data from the TRMM‐KWAJEX field campaign, which captures the evolution of mixed Rossby‐gravity (MRG) waves, this study evaluates how parameterization schemes influence convectively coupled MRG waves in the Community Atmospheric Model single‐column framework (SCAM). Four configurations are examined: the traditional approach that uses separate deep (ZM) and shallow (UW) convection schemes (CAM_ZMUW), unified shallow‐deep convection (CAM_UNICON), unified cloud‐turbulence (CAM_CLUBB), and super‐parameterization (CAM_SP).

doi:10.1029/2025jd045250.zh: 利用长期观测和可解释机器学习研究中国沙尘暴频率与强度的不同变化，区分普通和强事件驱动，分析近地面风及环境条件的作用。
doi:10.1029/2025jd045250.en: Abstract Dust storms (DSs) have significant impacts on human health, air quality, and terrestrial ecosystems. In recent years, the increasing frequency of extreme DSs has underscored the urgent need to better understand their historical characteristics and dominant drivers.

doi:10.1029/2025jd045109.zh: 结合三维闪电定位、雷达和电学模式，研究水凝物类型、数量及空间配置如何影响闪电通道的水平发展，连接雷暴微物理与电场结构。
doi:10.1029/2025jd045109.en: Abstract The shape of lightning channels reflects nature's intricate craftsmanship, shaped by intracloud electric fields influenced by the microphysical structure of thunderstorms. While previous studies have focused primarily on the relationship between vertically stratified charge structures and vertical lightning development, the relationship between thunderstorm microphysics and the horizontal development of lightning remains unclear.

doi:10.1029/2025jd044925.zh: 在统一排放输入下比较多模式南亚气溶胶辐射效应，分离长短波及云相互作用贡献，评估大气吸收与大气顶净强迫的不确定性。
doi:10.1029/2025jd044925.en: Abstract This study investigates effective radiative forcing (ERF) and atmospheric absorption due to aerosols over South Asia, focusing on changes in emissions from the pre‐industrial period to the present day. Utilizing four global climate models (GCMs), CAM5, CAM6, ECHAM6, and NICAM‐SPRINTARS, alongside a common regional emission inventory (SMoG‐India‐v1) and global Community Emissions Data System (CEDS) for emissions outside India, we assess the perturbations in shortwave (SW), longwave (LW), and net radiative fluxes resulting from aerosol emissions.

doi:10.1029/2025jd045498.zh: 通过区域陆气耦合试验区分青藏高原土地覆盖变化和植被增绿的作用，分析反照率、蒸散和地表能量分配如何改变温度、降水及径流。
doi:10.1029/2025jd045498.en: Abstract The Qinghai‐Tibet Plateau (QTP) has experienced significant vegetation changes in recent decades, including shifts in land cover types (grassland expansion) and greening. Nevertheless, the feedback mechanisms between vegetation changes and regional climate, as well as its impact on the hydrological cycles, are yet to be adequately quantified.

doi:10.1029/2025jd045698.zh: 利用树轮碳氧稳定同位素重建中国东部水汽压亏缺，研究温度与降水对长期大气干燥化的贡献，并比较未来情景下的持续变化。
doi:10.1029/2025jd045698.en: Abstract The vapor pressure deficit (VPD), defined as the difference between saturated and actual water vapor pressure, is a key determinant of atmospheric evaporative demand and a critical regulator of terrestrial carbon cycles. Understanding how rising temperatures influence VPD dynamics is therefore crucial in the context of global warming.

doi:10.1029/2025jd045068.zh: 比较不同分辨率 E3SM 中陆地极端降水对温度及饱和亏缺的依赖，发现允许对流模拟更能表现观测关系，提示湿度敏感的对流参数化需改进。
doi:10.1029/2025jd045068.en: Abstract Despite the well‐documented impact of spatial resolution on the model extreme precipitation intensity (EPI), it is unclear whether and how this might influence the relationship between EPI and meteorological conditions. In this study, we assess how this relationship is represented in the Energy Exascale Earth System Model (E3SM) at low (110 km), high (25 km), and ultra‐high (3.25 km, SCREAM) resolutions, using the Stage IV and IMERG data as observational references.

doi:10.1029/2025jd045146.zh: 利用动态再循环与拉格朗日轨迹模型诊断四川盆地夏旱，区分外部水汽输入不足和局地再循环变化，分析陆气反馈对干旱持续的放大。
doi:10.1029/2025jd045146.en: Abstract Frequent droughts in the Sichuan Basin (SCB) have caused severe socioeconomic impacts and significantly altered the regional water cycle. However, the connection between these droughts and the atmospheric water cycle remains unclear.

doi:10.1029/2025jd044630.zh: 结合气候网络、动力诊断与试验研究巴伦支海海冰损失和欧亚同步热浪，分析持续海冰异常与欧洲陆气反馈如何维持远程环流联系。
doi:10.1029/2025jd044630.en: Abstract Synchronous extreme heatwaves across Eurasia have become more frequent in recent decades, posing severe risks to ecosystems, society, and human health. Meanwhile, rapid Arctic Sea ice loss due to Arctic amplification has emerged as a crucial driver of extreme weather and climate events.

doi:10.1029/2025jd044772.zh: 利用多套观测评估青藏高原能量收支，发现显著季节性不平衡，讨论热带辐射—对流平衡框架直接用于高海拔地区的适用限制。
doi:10.1029/2025jd044772.en: Abstract Radiative convective equilibrium (RCE) critically constrains tropical climates, but its applicability to elevated terrains such as the Tibetan Plateau (TP) remains unknown. Based on 23 years (2001–2023) of multiple observational data sets, our study provides the first comprehensive observational assessment of RCE applicability over the TP.

doi:10.1029/2025jd045241.zh: 通过集合预报与受控区域模拟研究平流层极涡对子午向输送和美国东部降水的影响，强调极涡几何及最低平流层的区域耦合作用。
doi:10.1029/2025jd045241.en: Abstract Using ensemble forecasts from the Global Ensemble Forecast System and controlled integrations with the Weather Research and Forecasting (WRF) model, we investigate how the North American stratospheric sub‐vortex, closely linked to the 2019 sudden stratospheric warming (SSW), influences a large‐scale precipitation event over the eastern United States in late January 2019 and further quantify its contribution to the precipitation anomalies of the event. This precipitation event is directly driven by a tropospheric cyclone and a downstream anticyclone, which jointly transport warm, moist air from the Gulf of Mexico into the eastern U.S.

doi:10.1029/2025jd045879.zh: 提出从 PREFIRE 红外辐射测量反演分光出射长波通量的方法，结合角分布模型与未覆盖波段估计，并通过配对观测检验反演表现。
doi:10.1029/2025jd045879.en: Abstract The far‐infrared (>16 μm) spectrum plays a crucial role in Earth's radiation budget but was rarely observed from space before 2024. Two Polar Radiant Energy in the Far Infrared Experiment (PREFIRE) satellites, PREFIRE2 (SAT‐2) and PREFIRE1 (SAT‐1), were launched in 2024.

doi:10.1029/2025jd046175.zh: 结合 CALIPSO、源区追踪与辐射传输研究东亚高空沙尘，分离不同北半球源区的贡献及路径，评估其在不同高度的辐射影响。
doi:10.1029/2025jd046175.en: Abstract A thorough understanding of the sources, contributions, and transport pathways of airborne dust over East Asia is essential for evaluating its regional climatic and environmental impacts. Although widely used, numerical models yield uncertain dust loading estimates in receptor regions due to uncertainties in emission and deposition parameterizations.

doi:10.1029/2026jd047632.zh: 通过极端平流层烟尘情景模拟水汽输送变化，分析全球降温背景下强输送事件的减少与局地冷季走廊增强，评估水循环的非均匀响应。
doi:10.1029/2026jd047632.en: Abstract Nuclear war has the potential to cause global catastrophe, as soot from widespread fires blocks sunlight, triggers abrupt cooling, and collapses agriculture. This study examines the long‐term response of weather and climate patterns to nuclear conflict, simulated by injecting ∼150 million tons of smoke into the stratosphere within the Community Earth System Model.

doi:10.1029/2026jd047979.zh: 利用 WRF-Chem 研究沙尘与初生生物粒子对海风对流的影响，纳入粒子排放、破裂和云微物理，比较不同发展阶段的降水响应。
doi:10.1029/2026jd047979.en: Abstract Sea‐breeze‐induced convection plays a critical role in coastal weather but remains challenging to simulate due to complex aerosol–cloud interactions. Although mineral dust and primary biological aerosol particles (PBAPs) are known to act as cloud condensation nuclei and ice nucleating particles, their impacts on different convective cloud regimes and various cloud development stages are poorly understood.

doi:10.1029/2026jd047590.zh: 提出快速全天空高光谱红外辐射模型，将云层响应替代模型嵌入物理递归耦合框架，兼顾逐线气体吸收与多层云的散射、发射。
doi:10.1029/2026jd047590.en: Abstract Clouds strongly modify thermal infrared radiances through absorption, emission, and multiple scattering, yet rigorous line‐by‐line (LBL) gas absorption coupled with multi‐stream scattering remains too expensive for large ensembles of all‐sky hyperspectral simulations. We present a fast monochromatic radiative transfer (RT) model for the thermal infrared spectrum that retains the physical structure and vertical flexibility of the layered RT problem while embedding type‐wise trained radiative response models for the computationally dominant cloud‐layer scattering and emission calculations.

doi:10.1029/2025jd045957.zh: 利用温度依赖的冰粒子光学模型模拟南极高原远红外辐射，并与观测比较，评估冰晶形状和吸收性质对极地云辐射信号的影响。
doi:10.1029/2025jd045957.en: Abstract Longwave cloud radiative effects significantly influence variability in global and regional Earth systems. However, there have been very few, if any, measurements of the far‐infrared (FIR) radiation over the polar regions, where about half of the outgoing longwave radiation is in the FIR spectrum.

doi:10.1029/2026jd046965.zh: 从能量收支分析 CMIP6 北半球热带气旋季节转换偏晚，指出地表风速和潜热通量偏差可延迟哈德莱环流南移及气旋活动季节演变。
doi:10.1029/2026jd046965.en: Abstract Observed tropical cyclone genesis frequency (TCGF) over the Northern Hemisphere (NH) exhibits a clear seasonal transition from the peak season (July‐September) to the late season (October‐December). Correct simulation of TCGF seasonality has profound impacts on TC activity and disaster predictions.

doi:10.1029/2026jd047254.zh: 比较高低技巧次季节预报，区分西太平洋热带强迫与北大西洋—巴伦支喀拉海波列对华北 2025 年两个月极端降水可预报性的贡献。
doi:10.1029/2026jd047254.en: Abstract Accurately predicting persistent extreme precipitation remains a major challenge for subseasonal‐to‐seasonal (S2S) prediction models. This study identifies two distinct sources of predictability for the July and August 2025 extreme precipitation anomalies over northern China (NC) and reveals how these remote signals improved the prediction.

doi:10.1029/2025jd045928.zh: 结合南京长期花粉观测、气象和土地覆盖资料，研究近程源区、风湿条件及城市化变化对花粉浓度的共同作用。
doi:10.1029/2025jd045928.en: Abstract Airborne pollen is a sensitive biological indicator of interactions between meteorological processes and land cover. Prior research has emphasized meteorological influences, with less focus on long‐term land‐cover changes.

doi:10.1029/2026jd046688.zh: 结合再分析与大气模式研究西北太平洋秋季气旋生成，区分热带海温在年际尺度和中纬度海温在年代际尺度的环流调制。
doi:10.1029/2026jd046688.en: Abstract Tropical cyclones (TCs) in the western North Pacific (WNP) pose significant threats to socio‐economic systems, yet their variability during the autumn season remains relatively understudied compared to summer. This study examines the interannual and decadal variations of WNP TC genesis in autumn using reanalysis data sets and atmospheric general circulation model (AGCM) simulations.

doi:10.1029/2026jd047411.zh: 利用耦合模式研究理想化海洋云增亮的环流反馈，发现区域降温与风场减弱会减少自然海盐排放，从而部分抵消人为增加的粒子输入。
doi:10.1029/2026jd047411.en: Abstract Using a NOAA Geophysical Fluid Dynamics Laboratory coupled atmosphere–ocean (CM4) comprehensive model, we employ simulations of enhanced, geoengineered sea salt aerosol (SSA) emissions in the tropics to examine the circulation response to idealized marine cloud brightening. Increased tropical SSA emissions cool the deployment region and weaken the Equator‐to‐midlatitude temperature gradient, triggering circulation feedbacks that include weaker Southern Ocean westerlies.

doi:10.1029/2025jd045842.zh: 用卫星海冰资料和模态分析比较阿蒙森海夏冬变化，研究热带海温遥相关与区域海气冰过程如何在不同季节产生不同影响。
doi:10.1029/2025jd045842.en: Abstract Antarctic sea ice is undergoing significant changes associated with climate change. While previous studies have primarily examined temporal and spatial variations in Antarctic sea ice as a whole, this broad approach can obscure the specific dynamics of the marginal seas.

doi:10.1029/2025jd044468.zh: 提出将预报误差分为总量、覆盖面积和分布形态的综合评估方法，减少时空错位导致的双重惩罚，为数值及 AI 天气预报提供可解释诊断。
doi:10.1029/2025jd044468.en: Abstract Errors in weather forecasts remain a critical challenge for high‐resolution numerical weather prediction (NWP) and artificial intelligence forecast models. Traditional verification approaches, such as Threat Score (TS) and Equitable Threat Score (ETS), suffer from “double penalty” issues due to spatial‐temporal mismatches and lack of spatial distribution fidelity.

doi:10.1029/2025jd045982.zh: 利用全球变分辨率集合后报研究气候变化对 2020 年极端梅雨的影响，比较降水频率、强度及环流调整，并讨论归因结果对预报能力的依赖。
doi:10.1029/2025jd045982.en: Abstract This study investigates the impact of climate change on the extreme 2020 Meiyu over the middle and lower reaches of the Yangtze River (middle‐lower Yangtze River (MLYR)) through global variable‐resolution ensemble subseasonal hindcasts. Results reveal that post‐1980 climate change enhanced the 2020 extreme Meiyu rainfall over the MLYR region by approximately 14.67% at monthly scale, while simultaneously decreasing light and moderate precipitation frequency but intensifying heavy and extreme precipitation occurrences.

doi:10.1029/2026jd046858.zh: 识别青藏高原夏季复合干热事件的主要年际模态，分析 ENSO 与夏季北大西洋涛动的区域作用及正负位相响应差异。
doi:10.1029/2026jd046858.en: Abstract Associated with a warming tendency, a large variability of compound hot‐dry events (CHDEs) is evident in the Tibetan Plateau (TP), but the underlying mechanisms remain poorly understood. In this study, we analyze the interannual variability of summer CHDEs over the TP, identify the key large‐scale climate drivers, and reveal the dominant underlying physical mechanisms.

doi:10.1029/2026jd046616.zh: 用高维非线性分解诊断晨间土壤湿度与午后降水联系，揭示传统相关分析和允许对流模式可能低估陆气状态的协同及非线性影响。
doi:10.1029/2026jd046616.en: Abstract Soil moisture‐precipitation coupling critically shapes Earth's water and energy cycles, yet it remains difficult to quantify because land‐atmosphere interactions are nonlinear, multivariate, and state‐dependent. This study applies the High‐Dimensional Model Representation (HDMR) framework to observation‐based data sets over the contiguous United States to diagnose temporal SM‐precipitation amount coupling, defined here as the influence of morning land‐atmosphere states on same‐day afternoon rainfall.

doi:10.1029/2026jd046751.zh: 利用水汽示踪剂分离北极降水的本地与远程来源，研究增暖和海冰消退如何提高本地海洋贡献，并分析这一比例在海冰消失后的变化。
doi:10.1029/2026jd046751.en: Abstract Snow and rain are increasing in the Arctic. Climate model projections indicate a 50% increase in precipitation by the end of the century.

doi:10.1029/2025jd045570.zh: 通过理想化对流试验研究热带海洋环境中的冰雹，解释零度层以下净浮力如何同时影响过冷水供给、冰雹增长及下落融化。
doi:10.1029/2025jd045570.en: Abstract Building on a previous study showing that NetCAPE0C—formulated as CAPE calculated up to the 0C isotherm, after subtracting CIN and correcting for water loading—is effective in predicting hail occurrence in maritime tropical (mT) environments, we examined the microphysics to understand why , particularly for ordinary pulse storms. A suite of idealized Cloud Model 1 (CM1) simulations, created by systematically varying CAPE and CIN to generate different NetCAPE0C values, was analyzed as hydrometeors progressed from condensate to hail.

doi:10.1029/2026jd047324.zh: 结合站点与再分析研究长江流域区域性复合干热事件，比较长期和次季节变化，识别不同环流型如何通过云量、辐射和下沉影响高温少雨。
doi:10.1029/2026jd047324.en: Abstract Based on daily station observations and ERA5 reanalysis data during warm seasons of 1961–2024, the characteristics of regional compound dry‐hot events (RCDHEs) and associated mechanisms over Yangtze River Basin (YRB) have been systematically explored. Results show more than 45% of the total occurrence days (OD) of compound dry‐hot events (CDHEs) over most YRB in warm season is contributed by the RCDHEs, which show distinct sub‐seasonal variations and concentrate in mid‐June to mid‐July.

doi:10.1029/2026jd046794.zh: 结合机载拉曼激光雷达、尾部多普勒雷达和实测资料，区分台风雨带低云、对流及层状降水，揭示传统观测难以解析的云边界与非对称结构。
doi:10.1029/2026jd046794.en: Abstract Low‐level clouds in the tropical cyclone (TC) rainbands modulate the radial inflow of warm, moist boundary layer air, which can impact TC intensity. Yet, precisely measuring rainband cloud boundaries with existing remote sensing techniques remains a challenge.

doi:10.1029/2026jd046344.zh: 联合短波辐射、激光雷达和云雷达反演云与毛毛雨性质，减少大雨滴掩盖云滴信号的问题，为暖雨形成及气溶胶—云—降水关系提供观测。
doi:10.1029/2026jd046344.en: Abstract Drizzle, a common feature of marine boundary layer clouds formed through collision‐coalescence, plays a key role in cloud microphysics and evolution. However, simultaneously retrieving cloud and drizzle properties from remote‐sensing observations remains challenging because drizzle droplets often dominate radar signals, masking cloud contributions.

doi:10.1029/2026jd047086.zh: 利用理想化二氧化碳增减试验研究陆地降水变率的非对称响应，比较日到季节内尺度，指出相同浓度下移除阶段仍可保持更强的水文波动。
doi:10.1029/2026jd047086.en: Abstract Precipitation variability describes fluctuations between wet and dry conditions and plays an important role in shaping hydrological extremes and their societal impacts. Using idealized carbon dioxide removal experiments from CMIP6 models, we assess how precipitation variability responds to symmetric CO 2 ramp‐up and ramp‐down forcing across time scales from day‐to‐day to intraseasonal.

doi:10.1029/2026jd046402.zh: 结合多频雷达与 WRF 评估冷空气爆发降雪中的凇附增长，诊断固定收集效率和风切变脱耦造成的偏差，为改进粒子微物理提供依据。
doi:10.1029/2026jd046402.en: Abstract Using the multi‐frequency radar suite, ground‐based observations, and the Weather Research and Forecasting (WRF) model with the Predicted Particle Properties microphysics scheme with the version of two‐ice category (P3‐2ice), we study the characteristics of a cold‐air outbreak (CAO) snowfall event on 6–7 December 2024. The cloud system is shallow convection, with the microphysical characteristics differing between the first and second snowfall periods.

doi:10.1029/2026jd046636.zh: 通过晚古生代边界条件下的轨道参数集合试验，连接季节日照、经向能量输送和热带辐合带变化，解释冰室气候中热带与高纬的耦合。
doi:10.1029/2026jd046636.en: Abstract Orbital variations redistribute seasonal insolation and can reorganize tropical rainfall, atmospheric circulation, and high‐latitude surface conditions. The energetic linkage among these processes during the late Paleozoic Ice Age remains poorly constrained.

doi:10.1029/2025jd045785.zh: 利用实验火场上风侧高频风观测分解湍流尺度，研究火致后侧入流如何选择性重分配能量，为火—大气耦合模式的湍流参数化提供约束。
doi:10.1029/2025jd045785.en: Abstract Wildfires alter local atmospheric conditions, yet the spatial extent and frequency‐dependent characteristics of fire‐induced inflow perturbations remain largely unquantified. This study applies Multivariate Empirical Mode Decomposition (MEMD) to analyze high‐frequency horizontal wind speed data from a tower positioned at varying distances (∼80–410 m) upwind of three wind‐driven experimental burns in gorse shrub fuels in Rakaia Valley, New Zealand.

doi:10.1029/2026jd047121.zh: 从印尼多站观测建立概率式基准日循环，适用于降水等非高斯变量，帮助区分局地太阳辐射、海陆风与更大尺度扰动的影响。
doi:10.1029/2026jd047121.en: Abstract Previous studies highlight strong influences of large‐scale synoptic, intraseasonal, and seasonal perturbations on the diurnal cycle of the Indo‐Pacific Maritime Continent (MC). Isolating local diurnal forcing of insolation from other effects can be difficult.

doi:10.1029/2025jd045656.zh: 结合再分析与 CESM2 分离北冰洋近地面风变化的外部强迫和内部变率，揭示冬夏主导过程不同及冬季强迫来源的年代转换。
doi:10.1029/2025jd045656.en: Abstract Changes in near surface wind speeds (NSWS) over the Arctic Ocean play a critical role in regulating sea ice drift, the surface energy budget, and sea ice‐atmosphere interactions. However, the drivers behind their long‐term variability and trends remain poorly understood.

doi:10.1029/2025jd045827.zh: 利用含海喷雾的大涡模拟研究飓风边界层热量、水汽和动量交换，检验液滴滞留及垂直源汇对整体通量系数的影响，并辨析数值伪影。
doi:10.1029/2025jd045827.en: Abstract The effects of spray on air‐sea fluxes in high‐wind environments have been studied for decades, and several models have been developed and implemented. Owing to the difficulties in making direct measurements in these conditions, however, many process‐level details of spray‐turbulence interaction remain unknown, and certain assumptions must often be made regarding droplet lifetimes and their interaction with background conditions.

doi:10.1029/2026jd046694.zh: 利用粒子分辨模拟训练机器学习替代模型，将黑碳包覆比例的非均匀分布引入全球分析，区分新鲜、过渡与老化粒子群的混合态特征。
doi:10.1029/2026jd046694.en: Abstract The climate impact of black carbon (BC) is strongly sensitive to the mass ratio of non‐BC coatings to BC (R BC ). However, current global climate models (GCMs) typically assume a uniform composition within individual BC‐containing particle populations, neglecting the significant particle‐to‐particle R BC heterogeneity.

doi:10.1029/2026jd046925.zh: 比较中国西南部仅白天与昼夜持续热浪的边界层过程，分析不同高压配置、低层增温和前期干土壤如何决定热异常能否延续到夜间。
doi:10.1029/2026jd046925.en: Abstract Compared to daytime‐ and nighttime‐only heatwaves, day‐night sustained compound heatwaves prove to be more impactful to human health, energy and agriculture sectors. Southwest China saw the most frequent occurrence of compound heatwaves across the country, and therefore needs heat type‐tailored forecasting and warning most.

doi:10.1029/2026jd046374.zh: 直接求解自由下落雪聚合体周围的非定常流动与六自由度运动，研究粒子几何如何影响姿态、速度及潜在碰撞增长。
doi:10.1029/2026jd046374.en: Abstract This paper reports the results of the first quantitative study on the flow fields of freely falling snow aggregates. The motions are investigated by performing numerical simulations of four snow aggregate models consisting of 2, 3, 4, and 5 conformally shaped dendrites of different sizes.

doi:10.1029/2025pa005357.zh: 利用美国犹他两湖植物蜡氢同位素重建过去两个冰期旋回的降水变化，比较冰盖背景下热力与水循环机制，为古气候模式检验提供记录。
doi:10.1029/2025pa005357.en: Abstract The growth and decay of the Laurentide ice sheet altered the hydrological cycle over southwestern North America. While it is well‐documented that the last glacial was wetter and had isotopically lighter precipitation, much less information is available for prior glacials.

doi:10.1029/2025pa005175.zh: 利用南极普里兹湾沉积捕获器时间序列研究海冰生物标志物输出，分析海冰变化与压载沉降过程，评估指标用于古海冰重建的条件。
doi:10.1029/2025pa005175.en: Abstract Understanding past sea‐ice variability in Antarctica is crucial for studying global climate change mechanisms. While a di‐unsaturated C 25 highly branched isoprenoid (IPSO 25 ) and its combination with phytoplankton biomarkers (PIPSO 25 ) are promising sea‐ice proxies, their applicability in Antarctica is limited by an incomplete mechanistic understanding of the processes transferring these biomarkers from the surface ocean to the sediment.

doi:10.1029/2025pa005301.zh: 综合铁形态、氧化还原敏感元素及同位素重建秘鲁陆缘环境，分析冰期旋回中生产力、缺氧和陆源输入对沉积指标的不同影响。
doi:10.1029/2025pa005301.en: Abstract Due to upwelling of nutrient‐rich waters, the Peruvian Margin is one of the most productive regions of the global ocean, hosting one of the most pronounced and shallowest oxygen minimum zones. This combination of high productivity and low oxygen makes the Peruvian margin a critical site for reconstructing past environmental changes.

doi:10.1029/2025pa005232.zh: 利用罗斯海峡谷堤岸浊积层重建高密度陆架水外流，探讨冰盖范围与陆架面积如何调节南极底层水形成，以及暖间冰期的间歇变化。
doi:10.1029/2025pa005232.en: Abstract Dense shelf water (DSW) formed on Antarctica's continental shelves is a significant precursor for Antarctic Bottom Water (AABW), a critical component of global overturning circulation. We hypothesize that DSW cascades off the central Ross Sea shelf generated density currents that entrained sediment as they flowed down Hillary Canyon, resulting in turbidite deposits on adjacent levees.

doi:10.1029/2025pa005143.zh: 结合佛罗里达湖泊温度与水文代用指标及耦合模拟，研究海因里希事件向副热带的气候传播，支持大气通道在区域温湿变化中的重要作用。
doi:10.1029/2025pa005143.en: Abstract Palynological analysis of a sediment core from Lake Tulane in south‐central Florida indicated major shifts in plant communities over the past 60,000 years which coincide with high‐latitude Dansgaard‐Oeschger cycles and the Heinrich Events (HE) that terminated them. To test the connection more directly between Heinrich Event and environmental change in Florida, we examined the distributions of branched glycerol dialkyl glycerol tetraethers (brGDGTs) across an interval of the Lake Tulane core spanning Heinrich Stadials 2–4.

doi:10.1029/2025pa005304.zh: 此条目已标记撤稿。原文曾用黄土多指标、年代学和模拟讨论潘帕斯地区冰期干旱与粉尘沉降；其结论不应作为可靠证据使用，须先查阅出版社撤稿说明。
doi:10.1029/2025pa005304.en: Abstract Understanding why proximal loess in southern South America (SSA) exhibits a contrasting evolution of dust deposition flux since the Last Glacial Maximum (LGM) compared to that of distal Southern Hemisphere (SH) archives remains a major unresolved problem. To shed light on this issue, this study examines dust emission, transport, and deposition in SSA over the past 43,000 years through multiproxy analysis of a Pampean loess section.

doi:10.1029/2025pa005269.zh: 利用斯科舍海海水锇同位素与冰筏碎屑等记录研究中更新世南极冰盖，尝试将区域冰下风化通量和动力变化从全球冰量信号中区分出来。
doi:10.1029/2025pa005269.en: Abstract Quaternary climate is characterized by glacial‐interglacial cyclicity, as evidenced by global benthic foraminifera (δ 18 O benthic ) records. These records, although temporally comprehensive and global in scale, do not easily highlight regional variations in ice sheet dynamics, making it challenging to decouple ice sheet behavior in the Northern Hemisphere from the Southern Hemisphere.

doi:10.1029/2025pa005307.zh: 通过南大洋有孔虫多指标重建 MIS 11 至 MIS 10 的混合与碳储存，探讨持续二氧化碳释放如何与逐步降温并存，并延缓冰盖增长。
doi:10.1029/2025pa005307.en: Abstract The climatic optimum of Marine Isotope Stage (MIS) 11, MIS 11c, was a remarkably long warmer‐than‐present climate interval with prolonged elevated atmospheric CO 2 levels. While the Pacific Southern Ocean has a strong leverage on atmospheric CO 2 through oceanic CO 2 release, past changes in carbon cycle dynamics in this region and their influence on atmospheric CO 2 during MIS 11 and the glacial inception to MIS 10 remain poorly constrained.

doi:10.1029/2025pa005326.zh: 比较末次盛冰期、中全新世和完整冰期旋回模拟中的南太平洋辐合带，分析海温梯度与雨带迁移，并指出模式与代用记录仍存在差异。
doi:10.1029/2025pa005326.en: Abstract The South Pacific Convergence Zone (SPCZ) is a dominant feature of South Pacific climate variability. Sensitivity of the SPCZ to changes in mean climate is investigated for a set of past climate simulations of Last Glacial Maximum (LGM, 21,000 years before present) and mid‐Holocene (6,000 years before present) from the Paleoclimate Modeling Intercomparison Project (PMIP).

doi:10.1029/2025pa005379.zh: 利用委内瑞拉珊瑚锶钙比延长热带北大西洋海温记录，比较区域水文极端与多年代际海温变化，为海气联系提供仪器观测前的证据。
doi:10.1029/2025pa005379.en: Abstract Sea surface temperature (SST) in the Tropical North Atlantic (TNA) ocean is a key component of the Atlantic Multidecadal Oscillation (AMO) and plays an important role in orchestrating hydroclimatic anomalies on adjacent continents. However, the narrow timespan of reliable instrumental SST records and the limited availability of paleoclimate SST records in the TNA region hinder our understanding of long‐term TNA climate variability.

doi:10.1029/2025pa005165.zh: 通过西印度洋放射虫组合重建晚中新世以来印尼贯穿流，区分表层和温跃层水团变化，分析海峡地形演化对跨海盆输运与海温的影响。
doi:10.1029/2025pa005165.en: Abstract The Indo‐Pacific Gateway is a narrow tropical passage connecting the Pacific and Indian Oceans, and alterations in its topographic configuration can significantly influence the volume of water exchanged between the two oceans through the Indonesian Throughflow (ITF). In the modern ocean, the ITF extends from the surface to a depth of 500 m, with its strongest flow occurring in the upper thermocline (100–300 m).

doi:10.1029/2026pa005517.zh: 利用葡萄牙湖泊植物蜡同位素并分离来源，重建全新世水分变化，研究北大西洋温度梯度及耦合海气动力对伊比利亚西部干湿演变的控制。
doi:10.1029/2026pa005517.en: Abstract Hydroclimate variability in western Iberia during the Holocene remains insufficiently resolved despite the high sensitivity of this region to the North Atlantic atmosphere and ocean dynamics. Here, we present the first source‐resolved reconstruction of centennial‐ to millennial‐scale moisture variability over the last 11,000 years using sediments from Lake Peixão (Portugal) based on compound‐specific hydrogen and carbon isotopes of plant wax n ‐alkanes, supported by bulk organic geochemistry and continuous X‐ray fluorescence elemental data.

doi:10.1029/2026pa005524.zh: 结合黄土年代学、多指标与古气候模拟，分析南美近源和远源粉尘通量的不同演变，讨论源区供尘、沉降条件与大气环流的共同作用。
doi:10.1029/2026pa005524.en: Abstract Understanding why proximal loess in southern South America (SSA) exhibits a contrasting evolution of dust deposition flux since the Last Glacial Maximum (LGM) compared to distal Southern Hemisphere (SH) archives remains an unresolved problem. To explore this, we examine dust emission, transport, and deposition in SSA over the past 43,000 years through a multiproxy analysis of a Pampean loess section.

doi:10.1029/2026jc024434.zh: 结合观测与高分辨率海洋模拟研究印尼海海温季节变化，指出季风驱动的上升下降流及温跃层调整可沿贯穿流路径放大海温变率。
doi:10.1029/2026jc024434.en: Abstract The governing mechanisms of sea surface temperature (SST) variability in the Indonesian seas, which exerts a significant influence on atmospheric convection and Indo‐Pacific climate, are investigated using observations and high‐resolution regional ocean model simulations. Observations show that SST variability is dominated by the seasonal band, accounting for approximately 68% of the total variance, with 45% and 23% corresponding to the annual and semi‐annual components, respectively.

doi:10.1029/2026jc024615.zh: 提出基于克服负浮力所需能量的海洋障碍层隔热指标，用全球 Argo 剖面建立气候态，补充单纯厚度无法描述的层结与冷水卷入阻力。
doi:10.1029/2026jc024615.en: Abstract Barrier layers (BLs) reduce vertical mixing and limit the cold‐thermocline‐water entrainment into the mixed layer, influencing a wide range of air–sea interaction processes and ocean dynamics. They are conventionally characterized by their barrier layer thickness (BLT), but BLT cannot quantify either the density‐stratification intensity or the cold‐entrainment resistance.

doi:10.1029/2025jc023293.zh: 联合声学、生物地球化学与影像观测识别罗科尔海槽浑浊层，区分悬浮粒子和生物回波，研究水动力对粒子聚集及横向输送的影响。
doi:10.1029/2025jc023293.en: Abstract Suspended and slow‐sinking particles, especially those concentrated within nepheloid layers, can act as pivotal mediators of oceanic carbon transport and benthic‐pelagic coupling. However, identifying nepheloid layers and distinguishing their composition (i.e., inorganic particles, phytoplankton, zooplankton, and fish) using only acoustic systems remains challenging due to limited multidisciplinary observations.

doi:10.1029/2025jc023972.zh: 结合现场观测、潮汐模型和卫星资料研究喀拉海峡非线性内波，区分内潮演化、背风波和锋面生成机制，解释复杂潮能转化。
doi:10.1029/2025jc023972.en: Abstract This work examines the diverse mechanisms underlying the generation of nonlinear internal waves (NLIWs) through the complex transformation of tidal energy in the Kara Gates, a large strait at 70.5°N separating the Novaya Zemlya Archipelago from Vaygach Island and characterized by intense tidal dynamics. In situ data were acquired in summer 2023 during the “MIPT Floating University expedition” at various locations within the strait, complemented by analyses of data derived from the updated Arc2kmTM tidal model and satellite observations of the ocean surface informed by prior research.

doi:10.1029/2025jc023528.zh: 通过楚科奇海连续断面观测追踪冰下藻华的发生至衰退，比较光照、营养盐和水文结构，分析海冰动力变化对冰下生产力的影响。
doi:10.1029/2025jc023528.en: Abstract In recent decades, evidence has emerged of phytoplankton growing beneath Arctic sea ice, in some cases forming massive blooms. Observed and predicted changes in the cryosphere highlight the need to better understand the development and progression of under‐ice blooms.

doi:10.1029/2025jc023507.zh: 通过漂流和冰系留沉积捕获器测量楚科奇海有机物输出，结合水团锋面与藻华分布，揭示锋面俯冲可显著增强浅陆架粒子向下输送。
doi:10.1029/2025jc023507.en: Abstract Under‐ice phytoplankton blooms in the Chukchi Sea are among the densest observed globally, and, together with sea ice microalgal and open water phytoplankton blooms, make the region one of the most productive in the Arctic Ocean. To better understand the factors influencing export of organic material captured by these blooms, free‐drifting and ice‐tethered particle interceptor trap arrays were deployed in the northeastern Chukchi Sea during the Tale of Three Systems cruise in June‐July 2023.

doi:10.1029/2024je008919.zh: 利用光谱混合分析描绘月球暑湾含尖晶石火山碎屑沉积，重新约束其分布范围与喷发结构，讨论异常成分及多阶段演化的可能解释。
doi:10.1029/2024je008919.en: Abstract The Sinus Aestuum (SA) dark mantle deposit (DMD) is a regional pyroclastic deposit on the central lunar near‐side. Spectra from the SA DMD are anomalous when compared to other DMDs and have been interpreted to represent a high abundance of the mineral spinel.

doi:10.1029/2025je008980.zh: 全球统计月球和水星撞击坑周围叶状地貌，区分撞击同期坍塌、触发滑坡和喷出物流，分析少数类似火星分层喷出物形态的成因。
doi:10.1029/2025je008980.en: Abstract Lobate forms emanate from impact craters and have morphologies indicating ground‐hugging emplacement via flow. We present global surveys of lobate forms on the Moon and Mercury.

doi:10.1029/2024je008819.zh: 整合祝融号高低频雷达与地形影像研究乌托邦盆地下层结构，将层状沉积、粗糙度和近表面碎块分布与洪水、风化及撞击演化联系起来。
doi:10.1029/2024je008819.en: Abstract The Zhurong rover, a key component of China's inaugural Mars exploration mission, successfully landed on the southern Utopia Planitia on 15 May 2021. Equipped with a dual‐channel ground‐penetrating radar (GPR), the rover conducted comprehensive investigations of the martian subsurface.

doi:10.1029/2025je009058.zh: 耦合水星磁层离子输运与多孔风化层溅射模拟，比较氢和氦离子的贡献，更新平均太阳风条件下表面侵蚀及外逸层供给的估计。
doi:10.1029/2025je009058.en: Abstract Ion impacts on airless bodies such as Mercury alter their surfaces and contribute to their exospheres via sputtering. Their exact contribution in comparison to other effects is still uncertain, but observations by the MESSENGER spacecraft largely indicated influences from micrometeoroids.

doi:10.1029/2025je009008.zh: 使用直接模拟蒙特卡罗方法研究土卫二水汽与冰粒子羽流，通过卡西尼观测约束喷口流量、温度和方向，分析未来探测最敏感的参数。
doi:10.1029/2025je009008.en: Abstract This study investigates the water plumes of Saturn's moon, Enceladus, using Direct Simulation Monte Carlo (DSMC) modeling to analyze venting dynamics and plume structures. Building on prior research, we employ a parametrized DSMC approach to model water vapor and ice particle flows, leveraging Cassini spacecraft data from instruments such as the Ion and Neutral Mass Spectrometer and the Ultraviolet Imaging Spectrograph.

doi:10.1029/2025je009196.zh: 结合祝融号可见光与短波红外光谱识别岩石较少尘覆盖的暗斑，其特征与富硅淋滤风化壳相符，为火星北部低地酸性水作用提供线索。
doi:10.1029/2025je009196.en: Abstract The Zhurong rover conducted in situ spectral investigations of southern Utopia Planitia, where the bedrock composition remains relatively unknown due to dust cover. Here we identify some spectrally distinct dark patches sporadically occurring on rocks by combining the Multispectral Camera and Short‐Wave Infrared data.

doi:10.1029/2024je008509.zh: 联合嫦娥五号雷达全波形反演与钻进压力，识别浅层月壤多层结构和岩屑，探讨附近小撞击坑喷出物叠加的历史。
doi:10.1029/2024je008509.en: Abstract Layered subsurface regolith structures and estimated regolith properties are crucial for revealing the evolutionary history of the Moon. We employed the Lunar Regolith Penetrating Radar (LRPR) onboard the Chang’E‐5 (CE‐5) probe, achieving high‐resolution imaging of the shallow regolith.

doi:10.1029/2025je009139.zh: 综述月球、火星、水星和金星的地壳结构与组成约束，比较厚度模型，强调重力反演的非唯一性及构造、火山地貌的辅助限制。
doi:10.1029/2025je009139.en: Abstract Understanding the structure and composition of planetary crusts is fundamental for unraveling the diverse geologic pathways of rocky bodies in the solar system. In recent years, geophysical missions have shed light on the crustal architecture of the Moon and Mars.

doi:10.1029/2025je009075.zh: 在乌托邦平原凹顶锥体属于泥火山的假设下，用喷发模型估计地下泥质储库深度与温度，讨论潜在宜居环境及采样目标价值。
doi:10.1029/2025je009075.en: Abstract The Vastitas Borealis Formation (VBF) has been hypothesized to represent sedimentary remnants of ancient northern martian oceans. Widely distributed pitted cones across VBF are interpreted as most likely mud volcanoes, whose source regions might have hosted habitable environments.

doi:10.1029/2025je009022.zh: 比较祝融号与毅力号风观测中的高频重力波，利用偏振关系推断传播方向，分析区域沙尘暴前后波活动及大气稳定度变化。
doi:10.1029/2025je009022.en: Abstract This study investigated high‐frequency gravity waves (HFGWs) with periods below 20 min observed by the Zhurong/Tianwen‐1 and Perseverance/Mars 2020 rovers between local time 09:00 and 11:00, from Ls 140°–165° in Mars Year 36. By analyzing the eccentricity of monochromatic wind perturbations in the horizontal wind data, HFGWs were identified via their predominantly linear characteristics in hodographs.

doi:10.1029/2024je008885.zh: 通过矿物学和地球化学研究火星陨石 NWA 16788，分析辉石环带、堆晶结构及冷却历史，讨论其对火星岩浆过程和陨石分类的意义。
doi:10.1029/2024je008885.en: Abstract We present a comprehensive study of a new Martian meteorite, Northwest Africa (NWA) 16788, found in the Sahara Desert in July 2023. This specimen constitutes the largest known individual meteorite of Martian origin, with a total weight of ⁓25 kg.

doi:10.1029/2025je009165.zh: 利用晓号无线电掩星解析金星热潮汐垂直相位，支持半日潮汐从云层加热区同时向上和向下传播，并通过动量输送影响超旋风切变。
doi:10.1029/2025je009165.en: Abstract The vertical structure of the thermal tide in the Venusian low‐latitude region (0–30 latitudes) was investigated by the Akatsuki radio occultation measurements. The result shows that the phase of the diurnal tide little varies in the vertical direction, while that of the semidiurnal tide tilts toward earlier local times with increasing altitude above 65 km and tilts in the same direction with decreasing altitude below 50 km.

doi:10.1029/2024je008834.zh: 利用阿波罗月壤硫化物的原位硫同位素发现不同源区混合特征，探讨经历光化学处理的硫如何进入月幔，以及与早期演化或大撞击的联系。
doi:10.1029/2024je008834.en: Abstract In situ sulfur isotope analyses of sulfides found in regolith particles from the recently opened Apollo 17 drive tube 73001/2 reveal variable 34 S/ 32 S and 33 S/ 32 S that range from that of typical lunar basalts to strongly 34 S‐ and 33 S‐depleted values (δ 34 S = −4.1 ± 0.35 to +1.5 ± 0.029; Δ 33 S = −2.8 ± 0.48 to −0.1 ± 0.27 (2σ)). All Δ 33 S and δ 34 S data are positively correlated.

doi:10.1029/2025je009108.zh: 分析晓号长期红外云顶温度频谱，识别金星开尔文波、罗斯贝波及可能的耦合结构，研究波周期和振幅随背景风变化的联系。
doi:10.1029/2025je009108.en: Abstract Planetary‐scale waves are expected to be crucial in driving the Venusian planetary‐scale atmospheric circulation, including the superrotation. To understand the interaction between the waves and the mean flow, we obtained temporal frequency spectra of the cloud‐top brightness temperature using thermal infrared images taken by the Longwave Infrared Camera (LIR) onboard Akatsuki over a period of 10 Venus years.

doi:10.1029/2024je008903.zh: 提出适用于月球雷达的自动衍射聚焦反演，抑制噪声与重叠干扰，利用嫦娥四号沿程资料重建介电常数和浅层结构。
doi:10.1029/2024je008903.en: Abstract China's Chang'E‐4 probe successfully soft‐landed on the lunar far side at Von Kármán crater in January 2019. Onboard, the Lunar Penetrating Radar (LPR) detected subsurface structures and properties such as dielectric permittivity, aiding in our understanding of regolith composition and origin.

doi:10.1029/2025je009171.zh: 利用 MAVEN 氩密度观测量化火星夜侧热层重力波功率，比较沙尘暴、地方时及季节条件，分析下层尘负荷与高空波活动的联系。
doi:10.1029/2025je009171.en: Abstract Gravity waves in the thermosphere of Mars are complex and variable phenomena capable of causing significant changes to processes in the upper atmosphere of Mars, which can affect atmospheric escape. The objective of this study is to determine how dust storm activity, variation in Local Solar Time (LST), and seasonal changes affect thermospheric gravity wave activity.

doi:10.1029/2025je009188.zh: 为火星气候模式建立非地形重力波湍流混合参数化，连接波动与涡扩散，检验其对高层示踪物输送、组分丰度和潜在逃逸过程的影响。
doi:10.1029/2025je009188.en: Abstract This paper presents a formalism of mixing induced by non‐orographic gravity waves (GWs) to integrate with the stochastic GWs scheme in the Mars Planetary Climate Model. We derive the formalism of GWs and their mixing under the same assumptions, integrating the two schemes within a unified framework.

doi:10.1029/2025je009242.zh: 结合毅力号影像、光谱与化学测量研究杰泽罗坑岩石包覆层，将尘土、硫酸盐和铁氧化物混合与晚期表面蚀变联系起来，约束水—岩—大气作用。
doi:10.1029/2025je009242.en: Abstract During the NASA Perseverance rover's exploration of the Jezero crater floor, coatings were commonly observed on rocks. These features may record past water‐rock‐atmosphere interactions on the crater floor, and understanding their origin is important for constraining the timing of potential water activity and habitability at Jezero.

doi:10.1029/2025je009179.zh: 通过火星大涡模拟研究沙尘辐射对对流边界层的影响，发现地表遮光与空中吸热可分别抑制低层混合、增强顶部湍流，并改变边界层高度诊断。
doi:10.1029/2025je009179.en: Abstract Mars has an abundant amount of dust in its atmosphere that can have significant effects on the structure and dynamics of the Convective Boundary Layer (CBL). In this study, we employ a Large Eddy Simulation (LES) configuration of the Mars Weather Research and Forecasting (MarsWRF) model to investigate the radiative effects of dust on the Martian CBL.

doi:10.1029/2025je008989.zh: 结合多光谱与高光谱遥感识别火星奥克夏平原含水二氧化硅，分析其地层分布和可能水成环境，为未来原位地质及生命标志保存研究提供目标。
doi:10.1029/2025je008989.en: Abstract Hydrated silica (SiO 2 ·nH 2 O; opal) is important for understanding the geological and aqueous history and habitability of Mars, owing to its genesis in a wide range of aqueous environments and its high biosignature preservation potential relative to other hydrated minerals. Utilizing multispectral CaSSIS and hyperspectral CRISM data, we investigated opal‐bearing deposits in Oxia Planum, the future landing site of the ExoMars “ Rosalind Franklin ” rover, in order to further assess the region's aqueous geology and astrobiological potential.

doi:10.1029/2026je009948.zh: 用土卫六三维大气模式研究微量烃和腈的季节分布，区分经向翻转与涡旋输送，并分析辐射冷却和绝热增温对冰云形成的控制。
doi:10.1029/2026je009948.en: Abstract The atmosphere of Titan, Saturn's largest moon, is home to a suite of hydrocarbons and nitriles that are primarily produced high in the atmosphere. These trace molecules are distributed away from their high altitude sources by Titan's atmospheric circulation, resulting in a seasonality in their stratospheric abundance.

doi:10.1029/2026je009892.zh: 利用蒙特卡罗模拟评估主动中子与瞬发伽马联合探测，研究在相同含氢量下区分火星浅层不同含水宿主组分及其深度分布的能力。
doi:10.1029/2026je009892.en: Abstract The Dynamic Albedo of Neutrons (DAN) instrument on the Curiosity rover has mapped subsurface hydrogen along an extensively analyzed 27‐km segment of its traverse in Gale Crater, revealing water‐equivalent hydrogen (WEH) of 1–6 wt%. Neutron die‐away measurements alone, however, cannot determine whether this hydrogen resides in adsorbed water, hydrated minerals, or ice.

doi:10.1016/j.epsl.2026.120364.zh: 关注月幔不完全翻转与约 39 亿至 35 亿年前高钛火山活动的联系。来源记录没有摘要，具体模型与地球化学证据需查原文。

doi:10.1016/j.epsl.2026.120363.zh: 关注洋中脊—转换断层交汇区玄武岩玻璃的硼体系，研究亏损地幔的组分。来源记录没有摘要，目前仅能据标题介绍主题。

doi:10.1038/s41558-026-02733-7.zh: 结合长期叶面积指数记录研究全球干旱区增绿与年际波动，发现降雨敏感性增加可能掩盖稳定性下降，并指出植被模型对这些变化的再现不足。
doi:10.1038/s41558-026-02733-7.en: Drylands are already undergoing large-scale change due to climate change, yet understanding of this response remains limited by observational gaps, conflicting satellite records and substantial model uncertainty. Here, considering trends and interannual variability based on leaf area index (LAI), we show persistent (1982–2020) greening across global drylands and increasing interannual variability.

doi:10.1175/jas-d-25-0163.1.zh: 在阿尔卑斯山高海拔环境观测雪花与霰／雹粒碰撞后的破碎过程，并据此改进云微物理中的次生冰生成参数化。观测到每次碰撞平均产生约 5 个碎片；改进在低于 −17°C、以非枝状晶体聚合体为主的温度区间尤其适用。
doi:10.1175/jas-d-25-0163.1.en: Observations at Jungfraujoch quantify snow–graupel collisions and refine a secondary-ice production scheme. Collisions produced about five fragments on average, with the updated formulation improving predictions in the cold, non-dendritic regime.

doi:10.1175/jas-d-25-0181.1.zh: 比较两组公里尺度热带环流模拟，评估显式对流和参数化对热带对流耦合赤道波及跨尺度能量传递的影响。显式对流模拟的向大尺度能量传递平均高约 50%，Kelvin 波和 Rossby 波也呈现与深对流相关的上尺度能量传递。
doi:10.1175/jas-d-25-0181.1.en: Compares convection-permitting and convection-parameterized tropical simulations to diagnose equatorial waves and interscale energy transfer. The convection-permitting run produces about 50% more upper-tropospheric upscale transfer on average.

doi:10.1029/2026jd047314.zh: 结合天气尺度与大尺度诊断、位涡、气旋相空间和 Lorenz 能量循环，分析 2025 年南美内陆形成的 Revegoca 气旋。研究指出，越过安第斯山的切断低压触发低层扰动，潜热加热和平均流切变共同增强其动能，使系统呈现不同于典型锋面气旋的热带特征。
doi:10.1029/2026jd047314.en: Analyzes the inland-originating Revegoca cyclone using synoptic diagnostics, potential vorticity, cyclone phase space and the Lorenz energy cycle. The study links its development to a Pacific-origin cutoff low, diabatic heating and barotropic energy conversion.

doi:10.1029/2026jd046686.zh: 利用三套过去千年的气候重建和超过 10 万个模拟北大西洋热带气旋，比较东太平洋型与中太平洋型厄尔尼诺的气旋响应。不同重建对海温型态和气旋生成、路径及强度的响应并不一致，显示古气候模拟中的 ENSO 空间结构会影响风险估计。
doi:10.1029/2026jd046686.en: Uses three last-millennium climate reconstructions and over 100,000 synthetic North Atlantic cyclones to compare eastern- and central-Pacific El Niño events. The cyclone response varies substantially among reconstructions, highlighting sensitivity to simulated ENSO patterns.

doi:10.1175/jcli-d-25-0684.1.zh: 通过混合层热收支分析研究 2020 年孟加拉湾东北部持续 94 天、峰值强度 1.8°C 的海洋热浪。晴空短波增暖、反气旋环流汇聚及下沉 Rossby 波促进其发展和维持；季风活跃期增强的潜热释放则推动衰减。
doi:10.1175/jcli-d-25-0684.1.en: Uses a mixed-layer heat budget to study a 94-day, 1.8°C marine heatwave in the northeastern Bay of Bengal. Clear-sky shortwave heating, gyre convergence and downwelling Rossby waves contributed to its growth and persistence.

doi:10.1029/2026gl122966.zh: 结合卫星、现场观测和拉格朗日粒子追踪，追踪极端降水产生的淡水如何进入加利福尼亚洋流的贫营养海区。中尺度以下涡旋和细丝输送使海表盐度、层结、营养盐及浮游生物群落发生显著变化。
doi:10.1029/2026gl122966.en: Combines satellite and in situ observations with Lagrangian particle tracking to trace floodwater into the oligotrophic California Current. Submesoscale eddies and filaments transport freshwater associated with changes in salinity, stratification and marine communities.

doi:10.1029/2026gl125204.zh: 基于南极 King Sejong 站全年气溶胶与云凝结核观测，估算海盐气溶胶对不同过饱和度下 CCN 的贡献为 43%–54%。与再分析资料比较，模式在 0.2% 过饱和度下对海盐来源 CCN 的估计低约 30 倍。
doi:10.1029/2026gl125204.en: Analyzes year-round Antarctic aerosol and CCN measurements to quantify sea-salt contributions. Sea salt accounts for 43%–54% of CCN, while reanalysis underestimates its contribution by roughly a factor of 30 at 0.2% supersaturation.

doi:10.1029/2026gl122785.zh: 通过全球气候模式试验比较地形高度与地表粗糙度对美洲低空急流和降水的作用。较高地形会增强急流，而森林地表的粗糙度可抵消部分增强；两种因素都会影响急流高度。
doi:10.1029/2026gl122785.en: Uses global climate-model experiments to compare terrain height and surface roughness effects on low-level jets over the Americas. Higher terrain strengthens jets, while rougher surfaces can offset some of that effect; both also influence jet height.
